美股盤後及經濟數據摘要
◼ 美股上週五全數下跌，市場持續擔憂 AI 基礎建
設高度依賴舉債支應資本支出，加上科技與半
導體股估值偏高及未來變現的疑慮，科技與半
導體股持續遭遇明顯賣壓，費半指數重挫
3.8% 。此外，賣壓逐步由大型科技股擴散至中
小型股，羅素 2000 亦下跌 1.7% 。另一方面，
中東局勢升溫引發原油供應疑慮， WTI 原油大
漲 3.6% ，也使市場對能源價格與通膨風險的
擔憂再度升高。川普先前與俄羅斯達成柴油供
應協議，希望增加供給以壓低燃料價格，但該
協議在美國國會面臨跨黨派反對，使市場對後
續供應增加能否順利落實仍存疑慮。個股方
面，CoreWeave(CRWV -US)重挫 11.91% ，公
司目前債務規模約 500 億美元，近期部分債券
價格大幅下跌、信用違約交換成本明顯上升，
使市場更加擔憂其融資成本與高度依賴舉債擴
張的模式；特斯拉 (TSLA -US)下跌 2.13% ，第二
代 Roadster 發表會一度帶動股價走高，但隨科
技股賣壓擴大，漲幅全數回吐並轉為收黑；蘋
果(AAPL -US)逆勢上漲 0.43% ，首款摺疊手機
iPhone Duo 開放預購後交貨時間迅速延至明年
1 月底，反映初期需求強勁。
◼ 標普 500 指數 11 個類股中 6 個上漲，其中能
源(+2.47%) 、公用事業 (+1.40%) 、必需性消費
(+1.31%) 表現較好；資訊科技 (-2.54%) 、通訊
服務(-2.45%) 、非必需性消費 (-1.17%) 表現較
差。
◼ 美國 9 月進口物價月增率由下修後的 0.5% 升
至 1.1% ，高於市場預期的 0.8% ，年增率亦由
6.7% 升至 8.1% ，創 2022 年 7 月以來最大漲
幅，顯示進口端通膨壓力持續升高。細項來
看，進口燃料價格月增 4.8% ，排除食品與燃
料後的核心進口物價亦月增 0.7% 、年增
6.2% ，反映價格上漲已不僅限於能源產品。其
中，AI 投資需求帶動電腦、半導體及相關設備
價格上升，使資本財進口價格連續兩個月月增
0.9% 。另一方面， 9 月工廠生產月增 0.3% ，
扭轉前月下跌 0.2% 的情況，但第三季工廠生
產季增年率由第二季的 5.6% 大幅降至 0.7% ，
顯示製造業動能明顯放緩。雖然 AI 投資持續支
撐半導體及相關產業，第三季半導體與電子零
組件產出大增 28.4% ，但部分 AI 設備需求仰賴
進口，對美國國內製造業的帶動效果相對有
限。
◼ 今日將公布 10 月 NAHB 房屋市場指數。
◼ 今日無重要公司公布財報。

通膨震撼連番來襲為何美債逢利空不跌？分析師：殖利率觸頂了 (經濟)
本周美國債市發生一件怪現象：消費者物價指數（ CPI ）和生產者物價指數（ PPI ）比預期火熱，理應重創公債價格、激
升殖利率，不料卻吸引買家踴躍進場，以致殖利率不升反降。專家指出，種種跡象指向美債殖利率已觸頂了，投資人應
留意。
近幾個月來，美國長期公債殖利率節節升高，基準的 10 年期美債殖利率最近衝上 5.36% ，大約是 24 年來最高水準，
從抵押房貸到小型股都備感壓力。殖利率上揚時，債券價格下跌。

評論及分析  (黃昱瑋)
上週三美國公布 9 月 CPI 通膨數據高於預期時，短線上 10 年期美債殖利率一度升高逾 10 個基點，但後續隨著美國科
技股遭遇賣壓，以及市場風險情緒轉趨保守，使得美債迎來避險買盤逢低進場，帶動殖利率當日走降逾 20 基點，後續
公布之生產者物價 PPI 雖亦高於預期，但美債市場仍維持走降趨勢，顯示近幾個月高攀之殖利率已能吸引部分市場投資
人，而科技股重挫則成為驅動資金流入之觸發點。

然而，美債殖利率的回落是出自於市場資金避險需求，並非由經濟和貨幣政策基本面驅動，未來一旦股市風險情緒修
復，資金將可能再度離開美債市場，因為當前不論是結構或是循環面因素皆不利中長天期美債殖利率走降。首先，結構
因素上，美國債務紀律仍在惡化，截至今年 9 月 30 日之美國財年 26 財政赤字佔 GDP 為 6.2% ，較年初國會預算辦公
室(CBO) 預估之 5.8% 明顯高出許多，且未來 AI 企業發債潮延續下也將吸納市場資金不利美債融資；此外，川普個人之
政策風險包含立場反覆搖擺、頻繁之供給面政策干擾近年已推升美債期限溢價 (Term Premium) ，未來剩餘兩年任期內仍
不容忽視其政策風險對美債之影響。在循環因素上，今年來美伊衝突大幅推高能源價格，使得通膨反彈，且高油價持續
已久導致企業成本大幅增加，未來企業仍將可能轉嫁到終端售價上，故通膨不確定性亦高；再者，隨著 AI 熱潮帶動企
業擴大投資、美國內需消費因為退稅、財富效果等維持韌性，市場自第三季來多有上修美國今明年 GDP 成長預估，上
述循環趨勢皆導致 Fed 今年來政策立場逐漸偏向鷹派，本來 3 月點陣圖仍預估今明年各降息一碼， 9 月時已有高達八位
官員預估明年將升息至第三碼。因此，總結而論，近期美債殖利率走降 是出自於避險買盤驅動，並非景氣基本面已轉向
有利殖利率走降之階段，未來在美債結構和循環性利空皆未消散前，仍建議美債操作上謹慎保守，短線上較不建議積極
進場追價。

3Q26 法說預覽：利基需求支撐長期獲利
重要訊息
旺宏將於 10/27 公告 3Q26 財報並 召開法說會 。
評論及分析
產出與庫存限制 3Q26 出貨，ASP 提升支撐毛利。3Q26 營收 242.3 億元，
達我們預估的 91.6% 。儘管 NOR/SLC NAND/eMMC 報價分別季增約 40-
60%/70 -100%/20 -30% ，營收僅季增 26.7% ，我們推測主因為： (1) 1H26
將 NOR/ROM 產能轉向 eMMC ，造成轉換期間的產出損失； (2) NOR/SLC
NAND 庫存 較低 ；(3) eMMC 良率提升不如預期。上述因素 導致 NOR/SLC
NAND 出貨量季減， eMMC 則僅小幅季增。不過， ASP 上漲仍 將帶動毛利率
提升至 71.5% ，EPS 預估調整至 6.1 元。
預估 4Q26 EPS 8.2 元。展望 4Q26， 我們預期 ：(1) SLC NAND 報價續漲 40%；
(2) eMMC 漲幅收斂至個位數； (3) 旺宏 NOR 報價策略將明顯較華邦電 (2344
TT，NT$161.5 ，增加持股)保守，主因產能與庫存較為受限。位元出貨方面，
隨 TLC/MLC 良率持續改善 ，eMMC 出貨量可望季增 15%；惟SLC NAND/NOR
受限於庫存有限、產能未提升，出貨量將大致持平。我們預估 4Q26 營收達
292.3 億元，季增 20.6% ，毛利率提升至 75.6% ，修正 EPS 預估至 8.2 元。
利基需求支撐價格地板，長期獲利具延續性。 展望 2027-28 年，受惠 Edge AI
裝置、Boot Drive 及航太國防等重視可靠度的利基應用需求穩健，我們預期
SLC NAND/NOR 供需仍將緊俏，報價維持高檔； eMMC 則以車用需求最為穩
定 。 若設備順利進駐 ， 旺宏預計於4Q27 新增 2.1k 3D NAND 與 4k 12 吋 NOR
產能，並於 1H28 貢獻產出，主要為支應上述應用需求。我們將 2027 年營收
預估修正至 1,446.5 億元，毛利率 77.9% ，EPS 42.8 元。儘管受限於漲幅放
緩與產能有限，短期獲利增速不如原先預期，考量上述利基應用將支撐 Flash
價格地板，我們仍看好旺宏長期獲利的延續性。
投資建議
考量獲利成長低於原先預期，我們將目標本益比下修至 5 倍(相較利基型記憶
體龍頭南亞科 (2408 TT ，NT$447.5 ，增加持股)的 7 倍)，以 2026-27 年 EPS
為評價基礎，目標價 155 元。惟長期獲利仍穩健，且目前評價具吸引力，維
持旺宏「增加持股」評等 。
投資風險
擴產設備進機時辰延後 、工廠營運與人力面臨瓶頸。

半導體產業

IC 設計產業展望分岐
重要訊息
本期報告聚焦於： (1) 9 月營收重點分析； (2)非 AI IC 設計產業：終端需求轉
弱與製造成本攀升形成雙重壓力； (3)封測產業迎來數十年難得一見的機會。
評論及分析
9 月營收年增率 、 月增率皆優於過去五年平均。台灣半導體 9 月營收達 12,578
億元，年增 60%、月增 8%，優於五年平均的年增 23%與月增 5%。晶圓代
工方面 ， 台積電(2330 TT，NT$2,420， 增加持股)受惠 AI 運算需求強勁 、iPhone
新機備貨及 N2 加速量產， 營收年增55%；OSAT 受惠晶圓廠外包需求強勁及
價格調漲，營收年增 41%、月增 5%。IC 設計營收年增 15%、月減 8%，月
減主因提前拉貨、 PC/NB 需求疲弱及漲價效益尚未完全反映，惟 iPhone 備貨
提供部分支撐。 ASIC 設計服務營收年增 179% 、月增 17% ，其中創意 (3443
TT，NT$7,480 ，增加持股 )與世芯-KY (3661 TT，NT$3,685 ，增加持股 )營收
分別年增 98% 與 496% ，皆受惠晶圓取得優於預期及 CPU/ASIC 專案放量。
測試介面營收年增 66% 、月減 10% ，其中穎崴 (6515 TT，NT$5,160 ，增加
持股)月減 27%，主因探針卡大量出貨階段接近尾聲，且客戶集中使單月營收
波動較大 。
非 AI IC 設計業者面臨需求疲弱及成本攀升雙重壓力 。3Q26 全球 PC 出貨量
年減 24%、季減 14%，受記憶體漲價、關鍵零組件短缺及 1H26 提前拉貨衝
擊 ， 部分IC 設計業者的筆電業務較正常水準減少約 30-50%。 我們預估4Q26
PC 出貨再季減 12% ，2027 年出貨年減 12% 至 2.05 億台，且庫存調整壓力
恐延續至 2027 年初，需求至 3Q-4Q27 才逐步改善。成本端，成熟製程晶圓
代工與封測持續漲價，但標準型 DDIC 等競爭激烈的產品轉嫁能力有限，低成
本庫存對毛利率的支撐也將逐步消退，我們預期產業毛利率將進一步分化。
展望 2027 年，成長將仰賴高速介面與網通規格升級、車用 DDIC/TDDI 等利
基產品及市占率提升， 而非終端市場全面復甦，產品組合佳、具技術差異化與
定價能力的業者營運韌性較強。 IC 設計業者中，我們首選聯發科 (2454 TT ，
NT$4,250 ，增加持股 )、信驊(5274 TT ，NT$16,480 ，增加持股 )及達發(6526
TT，NT$783 ，增加持股 )。
封測產業迎來數十年難得一見的機會。 台灣前八大封測廠年初迄今已上修
2026 年資本支出 45.9% 至 4,839 億元，創歷史新高，較 2025 年幾乎翻倍。
我們認為大幅擴產反映： (1) AI 晶片出貨強勁帶動既有業務成長； (2) 晶片尺寸
擴大及設計複雜度提高消耗更多產能； (3) 台積電將資源重新配置至先進製程
與先進封裝 ， 並逐步退出晶圓測試(CP) 等低毛利業務 ， 且上述動能均屬結構性
因素，我們預期未來兩年資本支出仍將維持高檔。根據初步估算及供應鏈調
查，AI 晶片 CP 測試營收規模預估達 500-600 億元，在每投入 1 元資本支出
可創造 0.5 元營收的假設下，所需資本支出將超過 1,000 億元，占 2026 年封
測廠整體資本支出 20-25%。 我們預估台灣封測廠資本密集度將由 2025 年的
28.9% 升至 2026 年的 44.1% ，部分公司甚至超過 100% ，遠高於半導體產
業平均的 15.5% 。
投資建議
我們推薦個股包括台積電、聯發科、日月光投控 (3711 TT ，NT$671 ，增加持
股)、南亞科(2408 TT ，NT$447.5 ，增加持股 )、環球晶 (6488 TT ，NT$902 ，
增加持股 )、研華(2395 TT，NT$685，增加持股)、信驊、創意、頎邦(6147 TT，
NT$207.5， 增加持股)、 旺矽(6223 TT，NT$5,205， 增加持股)及精測(6510 TT，
NT$3,120 ，增加持股 )。
投資風險
AI 資本支出下調；經濟衰退。

items.full_text:
【Raw_Inbox row21928】
檔案:華南投顧-2026年能源展-Memo-20261016.doc(Word 轉檔)
2026年能源展
太陽能模組：本次2026能源展，國內三家太陽能模組廠展示的產品方向有差異，元晶的天辰系列適用大型的工商業屋頂；聯合再生的鈣鈦礦矽晶堆疊適用太空太太陽能、前衛建築立面；茂迪的雙透光模組有降低成本、光擴散封裝等優勢，適用農業溫室、農業共生等。

元晶(6443)主要以高效能模組--天辰系列，採用210R新型電池片，最高瓦數來到625W，正背面可達到17級以上的抗風能力。是針對企業綠電採購設計的雙面模組。當模組在標準測試環境下正面出力為 625W 時，只要背面接收到地面反射的光線（大約增加 1% 不到的微幅增益），實際輸出功率就會達到 629W 或更高。

聯合再生(3576) 針對 2026 年國內爆發的工商業屋頂型光電與 CPPA 綠電需求，主打大尺寸（如 210/210R 電池片）高功率 TOPCon 模組。強化了鋁框與玻璃結構的正負風壓承受力，全面通過台灣多颱風環境所需的 17 級耐風試驗。現階段大型工商業/屋頂案場主力。
目前先將「鈣鈦礦薄膜電池」堆疊在傳統的「矽晶（TOPCon）電池」上的太陽能廠商。目前轉換效率已達到 26%，長期目標朝 30% 邁進（突破了傳統單晶矽發電效率 29.4% 的物理極限），預計 2027 年 6 月將與客戶正式進行實體測試。

茂迪(6244) 所推出的「雙玻透光太陽能模組」（如勻光式透光模組 XN-TJ-TD 系列），是針對台灣農電共生（漁電共生）以及 BIPV（建築整合型光電）市場開發的專利利基型產品。該系列全線搭載高效率 N 型技術，目前市面主力包含三種規格：
XN48TJ-TD：輸出功率達 395W，模組轉換效率為 15.41%。
XN40TJ-TD：輸出功率達 330W，模組轉換效率為 12.88%。
XN36TJ-TD：輸出功率達 295W，模組轉換效率為 13.65%。
利用前後雙層玻璃的結構，模組具備極佳的耐候性與結構安全性，廣泛應用於需要兼顧採光與發電的都市場域，如：精緻溫室農場、採光車棚、高檔雨遮、廊道陽台，及建築物的垂直玻璃帷幕。

台達電(2308) 首度公開亮相「預製型 SST（固態變壓器）直流電力解決方案」實機，主打 800VDC（800伏特直流電） 高壓架構。

台達電將中壓交流電直接一步到位轉換為 800VDC 直流電送入機架內部，SST 單體轉換效率高達 98.5%，使整體能源效率有感提升 4%-5%。
在相同的功率下，將電網電壓拉高到 800V，電流就會相應減半。這使得配線與母線導體可以大幅「縮徑」（變細），減少發熱耗損，並為電力擁擠的機櫃內部釋放出大量空間。

台朔新智能：現階段主力以磷酸鐵鋰 (LFP) 晶片與模組全面汰換傳統的鉛酸電池，強攻大型儲能、AI 機房、電動巴士與工業自動化。次世代（2027年後）押注在安全性和續航力更高的「全固態鋰電池」。
台電微電網：由「分散式發電（光電/風電）」、「儲能系統（BESS）」及「能源管理系統（EMS）」三大要素組成。平時與大電網並聯，一旦天災導致主電網斷電，微電網可立刻切換為「孤島模式（Island Mode）」獨立運轉，確保特定區域不中斷供電。但從台電的新電廠規劃來看，未來5年還是以天然氣機組為主要的發電來源。

items.story: Meta 3Q26財報前瞻：廣告營收年增加速(Tinuiti美國3Q26年增17%，前季11%)由單價上揚推動；Muse帶動評價恢復但財務貢獻仍待驗證；資本支出市場共識應不減反增。維持增加持股、12個月目標價上調至780美元(2027 GAAP EPS 23倍)。

【Raw_Inbox row22025】檔案:凱基投顧_META Meta_鄭傑懋_20261019.pdf
十月 19, 2026 研究網站: https://investment.kgisia.com.tw/Portal/Report/Index/Zh/R 1 
 
 
動態更新  軟體  ‧美國  
   
Meta 
(META.O/META US) 
   
 
 
 
3Q26 財報前瞻：Muse 大受歡迎但付費轉換率仍待檢驗  
重要訊息 
Meta 預計於台灣時間 10/22 凌晨公布 3Q26 財報。 
評論及分析 
廣告營收表現亮眼由單價上揚推動。 我們觀察 Tinuiti 數據顯示 Meta 美國
3Q26 廣告營收年增 17%較 2Q26 之 11%加速，我們認為主要由廣告價格上
揚推動而非曝光量，Birch 數據顯示 FB/IG CPM 年增率於 3Q26 平均達
30/44% 較 2Q26 之 9/22% 加速成長，催化劑包含 AdImpact 預估期中選舉政
治廣告支出 US$10.8bn 較 2022 年成長 20%，廣告需求強勁、曝光成長有限
外加 AI 提升轉換率推升廣告單價年增加速(vs. 市場共識成長減速) 。 
Muse 帶動評價恢復先行，財務貢獻仍待驗證 。Meta 代理人產品 Muse 在美
加地區推出後大受歡迎，Apptopia 數據顯示 Muse 推出 20 天內累計下載量
達 580 萬次，DAU 約 1 百萬人，我們認為係因：1)Muse 用戶結構約 46%為
46 歲以上(vs. ChatGPT 21%) ，意味中高齡用戶第一次接觸 AI 產品可能透過
Meta 渠道；2)Muse 在產品設計上較為激進，較 ChatGPT/Claude 不會拒絕如
預訂、付款等高風險操作。惟 Appfigures 數據顯示 Muse 推出 11 天後累計
營收約 US$27k 佔比 3Q26 營收微乎其微，我們試算 Meta One & Muse 每 1
億用戶及 3%滲透率假設下 2027 年營收增量 US$720mn/0.3%( 以 Muse 
US$20/mon 計算；vs. 月費 US$3-100)，故仰賴額外廣告及代理商務變現。  
資本支出市場共識應不減反增 。先前 媒體揭露 Meta 內部信顯示公司預計
2026/27 新增 3.5/7GW 容量至 7/14GW 應為樂觀情境( 簽約而非通電上線) 並
涵蓋租賃/JV/SPV 等供給，2Q26+7M26 租賃義務 US$347bn 係屬長期資料
中心基礎建設，我們預估 Meta 2027 自有建置量約 4GW 並以 VR 每 GW 平
均建置成本約 US$55- 60bn(vs. 先前預估 US$45 -50bn) 估算，資本支出約
US$200 -220bn 高於市場共識 12%。需求方面，Muse 提供免費用戶每周 1
億 Token 使用額度，我們估算 1 億用戶在 25% 使用量及特定參數規模、
GPU 使用效率假設下即須 0.5 GW 的算力建置需求。  
投資建議 
我們維持「增加持股」評等並調升目標價至 780 美元，係以 2027 年 GAAP
每股盈餘 23 倍換算。惟中性看待 Muse 短期變現成績 。 
投資風險 
消費者支出趨緩、市場競爭、額外的 法規要求、隱私議題。

項目 定義 
能源使用 
直接與間接能源消耗總量(十億焦耳) 
- 公司運營範圍內消耗之能源總量 
- 能源使用總量 = 直接能源消耗總量 + 間接能源消耗量 
- 總能源使用量包括購買的能源、生產的能源 
- 就公用事業而言，輸電/電網損耗為其業務活動之一部分，被視為總能源消耗，數據不包括為滿足能源使用而生產的電力（公用
事業為出售而生產） 
- 就公用事業而言，用於能源生產的煤、天然氣或核能等原料不屬於「總能源使用」項下 
購買之再生能源 
Primary 再生能源購買總量(十億焦耳) 
- 公司各種來源之能源消耗量與購買的能源中屬於自然界可再生者（太陽能、風能、水能、生物質能、地熱能）之量  
- 如無證據顯示再生能源由公司生產，則所報告的能源數據視為購買的再生能源 
再生能源使用率 再生能源占總能源消耗量之比例 
CO2 約當排放量 
直接 CO2 與 CO2 約當排放量(公噸) 
- 公司擁有或控制的來源的直接排放量（範圍 1 排放量） 
- 相關氣體：二氧化碳 (CO2)、甲烷 (CH4)、一氧化二氮 (N2O)、氫氟碳化物 (HFCS)、全氟化合物 (PFCS)、六氟化硫 (SF6)、三氟化氮 
(NF3) 
CO2 約當排放量營收比 
直接 CO2 與 CO2 約當排放量（公噸）銷售（百萬元）比 
- 公司擁有或控制的來源的直接排放量（範圍 1 排放量） 
- 相關氣體：二氧化碳 (CO2)、甲烷 (CH4)、一氧化二氮 (N2O)、氫氟碳化物 (HFCS)、全氟化合物 (PFCS)、六氟化硫 (SF6)、三氟化氮 
(NF3) 
廢棄物總量 
廢棄物總量(公噸) 
- 總廢棄物 = 無害廢棄物 + 有害廢棄物 
- 僅考慮固體廢棄物，但如液體廢棄物以公噸為單位呈報，則會將其加入求得包含液體廢棄物之總量 
- 對於採礦、石油與天然氣等行業，tailings、廢石、煤、飛灰等廢棄物亦考慮在內 
廢棄物回收率 
公司呈報的廢棄物回收率 
- 廢棄物回收率 = 廢棄物回收量/總廢棄物*100 
- 廢棄物轉化為能源或經由廢棄物焚燒產生能源視為廢棄物回收 
- 經由堆肥回收的廢棄物視為回收之廢棄物 
總取水量 
總取水量(立方公尺) 
- 由呈報組織直接或經水公司等中介機構從任何水源抽取的總水量 
- 水井、城鎮/公用事業/市政用水、河水、地表水等不同之水源均予以考慮 
環保支出 環保支出總金額 
- 所有用於環境保護，或防止、減少、控制環境因素、影響、危害的投資與支出，亦包括處置、處理、衛生、清理支出 
員工流動率 
員工流動率 
- 包括任何原因（自願或非自願）離開公司的員工，如辭職、退休、自然離職/死亡、醫療失能、冗員、裁員、重組、解僱、裁減
或定期合約到期 
- 員工流動率 =（離開之員工/平均員工人數）*100 
- 平均員工人數 =（本年末員工人數 + 去年末員工人數）/2 
- 本財年末員工數 =上個財年末員工數 + 新員工數 - 離開之員工數 
女性經理 
女性經理百分比 
- 女性經理占公司經理的百分比 
- 如有不同階層之百分比，如最高階、高階、中階、初階，則會考慮中階女性經理之百分比 
- 女性經理百分比 = 女性經理人數/經理總數*100 
女性員工 
女性員工百分比 
- 女性員工占公司員工總數的百分比 
- 女性員工百分比 = 女性人數/員工總數*100 
教育訓練總時數 
所有員工教育訓練總時數 
- 僅考慮員工教育訓練時數 
- 包括一般員工所有類型的教育訓練（如健康與安全、環境、急難事件救援、技能與職業發展） 
- 如果數據以天為單位，則乘以 8，係假設 1 天 =  8 小時工作 
每位員工教育訓練時數 平均每年每位員工總教育訓練時數 
股東治理分數 衡量公司用以反收購工具的有效性 
公司治理分數 衡量公司對最佳治理原則的承諾和有效性 
產品責任分數 衡量公司生產優質產品和服務的能力，且產品是否將客戶的健康、安全、整合性和數據隱私進行綜合考量 
社區關係分數 衡量公司對成為優良公民、保護公眾健康和尊重商業道德的承諾 
勞動力分數 衡量公司在員工工作滿意度、健康、工作場所的安全、多樣性、平等以及員工發展機會方面的成效 
資源使用指標 衡量公司在原物料、能源或水的使用效率，以及是否通過改進供應鏈來尋求更俱生態效率的解決方案

3Q26 財報前瞻：Muse 大受歡迎但付費轉換率仍待檢驗
重要訊息
Meta 預計於台灣時間 10/22 凌晨公布 3Q26 財報。
評論及分析
廣告營收表現亮眼由單價上揚推動。 我們觀察 Tinuiti 數據顯示 Meta 美國
3Q26 廣告營收年增 17%較 2Q26 之 11%加速，我們認為主要由廣告價格上
揚推動而非曝光量，Birch 數據顯示 FB/IG CPM 年增率於 3Q26 平均達
30/44% 較 2Q26 之 9/22% 加速成長，催化劑包含 AdImpact 預估期中選舉政
治廣告支出 US$10.8bn 較 2022 年成長 20%，廣告需求強勁、曝光成長有限
外加 AI 提升轉換率推升廣告單價年增加速(vs. 市場共識成長減速) 。
Muse 帶動評價恢復先行，財務貢獻仍待驗證 。Meta 代理人產品 Muse 在美
加地區推出後大受歡迎，Apptopia 數據顯示 Muse 推出 20 天內累計下載量
達 580 萬次，DAU 約 1 百萬人，我們認為係因：1)Muse 用戶結構約 46%為
46 歲以上(vs. ChatGPT 21%) ，意味中高齡用戶第一次接觸 AI 產品可能透過
Meta 渠道；2)Muse 在產品設計上較為激進，較 ChatGPT/Claude 不會拒絕如
預訂、付款等高風險操作。惟 Appfigures 數據顯示 Muse 推出 11 天後累計
營收約 US$27k 佔比 3Q26 營收微乎其微，我們試算 Meta One & Muse 每 1
億用戶及 3%滲透率假設下 2027 年營收增量 US$720mn/0.3%( 以 Muse
US$20/mon 計算；vs. 月費 US$3-100)，故仰賴額外廣告及代理商務變現。
資本支出市場共識應不減反增 。先前 媒體揭露 Meta 內部信顯示公司預計
2026/27 新增 3.5/7GW 容量至 7/14GW 應為樂觀情境( 簽約而非通電上線) 並
涵蓋租賃/JV/SPV 等供給，2Q26+7M26 租賃義務 US$347bn 係屬長期資料
中心基礎建設，我們預估 Meta 2027 自有建置量約 4GW 並以 VR 每 GW 平
均建置成本約 US$55- 60bn(vs. 先前預估 US$45 -50bn) 估算，資本支出約
US$200 -220bn 高於市場共識 12%。需求方面，Muse 提供免費用戶每周 1
億 Token 使用額度，我們估算 1 億用戶在 25% 使用量及特定參數規模、
GPU 使用效率假設下即須 0.5 GW 的算力建置需求。
投資建議
我們維持「增加持股」評等並調升目標價至 780 美元，係以 2027 年 GAAP
每股盈餘 23 倍換算。惟中性看待 Muse 短期變現成績 。
投資風險
消費者支出趨緩、市場競爭、額外的 法規要求、隱私議題。

項目 定義
能源使用
直接與間接能源消耗總量(十億焦耳)
- 公司運營範圍內消耗之能源總量
- 能源使用總量 = 直接能源消耗總量 + 間接能源消耗量
- 總能源使用量包括購買的能源、生產的能源
- 就公用事業而言，輸電/電網損耗為其業務活動之一部分，被視為總能源消耗，數據不包括為滿足能源使用而生產的電力（公用
事業為出售而生產）
- 就公用事業而言，用於能源生產的煤、天然氣或核能等原料不屬於「總能源使用」項下
購買之再生能源
Primary 再生能源購買總量(十億焦耳)
- 公司各種來源之能源消耗量與購買的能源中屬於自然界可再生者（太陽能、風能、水能、生物質能、地熱能）之量
- 如無證據顯示再生能源由公司生產，則所報告的能源數據視為購買的再生能源
再生能源使用率 再生能源占總能源消耗量之比例
CO2 約當排放量
直接 CO2 與 CO2 約當排放量(公噸)
- 公司擁有或控制的來源的直接排放量（範圍 1 排放量）
- 相關氣體：二氧化碳 (CO2)、甲烷 (CH4)、一氧化二氮 (N2O)、氫氟碳化物 (HFCS)、全氟化合物 (PFCS)、六氟化硫 (SF6)、三氟化氮
(NF3)
CO2 約當排放量營收比
直接 CO2 與 CO2 約當排放量（公噸）銷售（百萬元）比
- 公司擁有或控制的來源的直接排放量（範圍 1 排放量）
- 相關氣體：二氧化碳 (CO2)、甲烷 (CH4)、一氧化二氮 (N2O)、氫氟碳化物 (HFCS)、全氟化合物 (PFCS)、六氟化硫 (SF6)、三氟化氮
(NF3)
廢棄物總量
廢棄物總量(公噸)
- 總廢棄物 = 無害廢棄物 + 有害廢棄物
- 僅考慮固體廢棄物，但如液體廢棄物以公噸為單位呈報，則會將其加入求得包含液體廢棄物之總量
- 對於採礦、石油與天然氣等行業，tailings、廢石、煤、飛灰等廢棄物亦考慮在內
廢棄物回收率
公司呈報的廢棄物回收率
- 廢棄物回收率 = 廢棄物回收量/總廢棄物*100
- 廢棄物轉化為能源或經由廢棄物焚燒產生能源視為廢棄物回收
- 經由堆肥回收的廢棄物視為回收之廢棄物
總取水量
總取水量(立方公尺)
- 由呈報組織直接或經水公司等中介機構從任何水源抽取的總水量
- 水井、城鎮/公用事業/市政用水、河水、地表水等不同之水源均予以考慮
環保支出 環保支出總金額
- 所有用於環境保護，或防止、減少、控制環境因素、影響、危害的投資與支出，亦包括處置、處理、衛生、清理支出
員工流動率
員工流動率
- 包括任何原因（自願或非自願）離開公司的員工，如辭職、退休、自然離職/死亡、醫療失能、冗員、裁員、重組、解僱、裁減
或定期合約到期
- 員工流動率 =（離開之員工/平均員工人數）*100
- 平均員工人數 =（本年末員工人數 + 去年末員工人數）/2
- 本財年末員工數 =上個財年末員工數 + 新員工數 - 離開之員工數
女性經理
女性經理百分比
- 女性經理占公司經理的百分比
- 如有不同階層之百分比，如最高階、高階、中階、初階，則會考慮中階女性經理之百分比
- 女性經理百分比 = 女性經理人數/經理總數*100
女性員工
女性員工百分比
- 女性員工占公司員工總數的百分比
- 女性員工百分比 = 女性人數/員工總數*100
教育訓練總時數
所有員工教育訓練總時數
- 僅考慮員工教育訓練時數
- 包括一般員工所有類型的教育訓練（如健康與安全、環境、急難事件救援、技能與職業發展）
- 如果數據以天為單位，則乘以 8，係假設 1 天 =  8 小時工作
每位員工教育訓練時數 平均每年每位員工總教育訓練時數
股東治理分數 衡量公司用以反收購工具的有效性
公司治理分數 衡量公司對最佳治理原則的承諾和有效性
產品責任分數 衡量公司生產優質產品和服務的能力，且產品是否將客戶的健康、安全、整合性和數據隱私進行綜合考量
社區關係分數 衡量公司對成為優良公民、保護公眾健康和尊重商業道德的承諾
勞動力分數 衡量公司在員工工作滿意度、健康、工作場所的安全、多樣性、平等以及員工發展機會方面的成效
資源使用指標 衡量公司在原物料、能源或水的使用效率，以及是否通過改進供應鏈來尋求更俱生態效率的解決方案

2026 年 10 月 19 日 美國 
   
投資領航日報 
   
 
環球總體經濟與股市  
◼ 美股上週五全數下跌，市場持續擔憂 AI 基礎建設高度依賴舉債支應資本
支出，加上科技與半導體股估值偏高及未來變現的疑慮，科技與半導體
股持續遭遇明顯賣壓，費半指數重挫 3.8% 。此外，賣壓逐步由大型科技
股擴散至中小型股，羅素 2000 亦下跌 1.7% 。另一方面，中東局勢升溫
引發原油供應疑慮， WTI 原油大漲 3.6% ，也使市場對能源價格與通膨風
險的擔憂再度升高。川普先前與俄羅斯達成柴油供應協議，希望增加供
給以壓低燃料價格，但該協議在美國國會面臨跨黨派反對，使市場對後
續供應增加能否順利落實仍存疑慮。個股方面， CoreWeave(CRWV -US)
重挫 11.91% ，公司目前債務規模約 500 億美元，近期部分債券價格大
幅下跌、信用違約交換成本明顯上升，使市場更加擔憂其融資成本與高
度依賴舉債擴張的模式；特斯拉 (TSLA -US)下跌 2.13% ，第二代 Roadster
發表會一度帶動股價走高，但隨科技股賣壓擴大，漲幅全數回吐並轉為
收黑；蘋果 (AAPL -US) 逆勢上漲 0.43% ，首款摺疊手機 iPhone Duo 開放
預購後交貨時間迅速延至明年 1 月底，反映初期需求強勁。  
◼ 標普 500 指數 11 個類股中 6 個上漲，其中能源 (+2.47%) 、公用事業
(+1.40%) 、必需性消費 (+1.31%) 表現較好；資訊科技 (-2.54%) 、通訊服
務(-2.45%) 、非必需性消費 (-1.17%) 表現較差。  
◼ 美國 9 月進口物價月增率由下修後的 0.5% 升至 1.1% ，高於市場預期的
0.8% ，年增率亦由 6.7% 升至 8.1% ，創 2022 年 7 月以來最大漲幅，顯
示進口端通膨壓力持續升高。細項來看，進口燃料價格月增 4.8% ，排除
食品與燃料後的核心進口物價亦月增 0.7% 、年增 6.2% ，反映價格上漲
已不僅限於能源產品。其中， AI 投資需求帶動電腦、半導體及相關設備
價格上升，使資本財進口價格連續兩個月月增 0.9% 。另一方面， 9 月工
廠生產月增 0.3% ，扭轉前月下跌 0.2% 的情況，但第三季工廠生產季增
年率由第二季的 5.6% 大幅降至 0.7% ，顯示製造業動能明顯放緩。雖然
AI 投資持續支撐半導體及相關產業，第三季半導體與電子零組件產出大
增 28.4% ，但部分 AI 設備需求仰賴進口，對美國國內製造業的帶動效果
相對有限。  
◼ 今日將公布 10 月 NAHB 房屋市場指數。  
◼ 今日無重要公司公布財報。  
產業脈動與個 股追蹤

LPDDR 頻寬可能逐漸成為瓶頸，而  HBM 的功耗特性則可能限制電池供電機器人的持續運作時間。  
Micron 此前預估，未來高階  AI 人形機器人的記憶體需求可能提升至  200 GB 以上，並搭配數  TB NAND 儲存容量，

端側 AI 推論的重要記憶體解決方案，並帶動記憶體需求由雲端  AI 伺服器進一步擴展至實體  AI 裝置。不過，相關技

Anthropic 表示 AI 導入後，每人程式碼產量、每名業務成交量與合約處理量都有提升；但公司也承認更多程式碼不一
定 代表更 高品質 或更大 商業 影響。 另一方 面，每 位員 工的會 議時間 較一年 前增 加  20% ，技 術個人 貢獻者 則增加  
16% ，公司將此歸因於人際信任、責任歸屬與面對面協作仍不可取代。  
Anthropic 預估 AI 可將美國  GDP 推升至 US$44tn ，並呼籲建立更嚴格  AI 規則 (鄭傑懋) 
Anthropic 共同創辦人 Jack Clark 表示，公司內部模型預估，若  AI 技術持續進步，美國  GDP 到 2030 年可能由目前約  
US$30tn 增至 US$44tn ，增幅接近 50%。他坦言這項預測「聽起來非常誇張」 ，但認為 AI 正在帶來重大的科學突破。  
Clark 表示，若 GDP 真能成長至此規模，依經濟理論必須出現新的產業與發明來支撐這波擴張。他並預期未來幾年不
只 AI，整體科學進展速度也可能加快。  
Clark 同時呼籲全球合作建立「非常規且嚴格」的  AI 規則，並表示政策制定者可採取行動的時間有限。他警告， AI 
發展可能逐步超出人類控制，未來可能同時帶來巨大財富與重大風險。

環球總體經濟與股市
◼ 美股上週五全數下跌，市場持續擔憂 AI 基礎建設高度依賴舉債支應資本
支出，加上科技與半導體股估值偏高及未來變現的疑慮，科技與半導體
股持續遭遇明顯賣壓，費半指數重挫 3.8% 。此外，賣壓逐步由大型科技
股擴散至中小型股，羅素 2000 亦下跌 1.7% 。另一方面，中東局勢升溫
引發原油供應疑慮， WTI 原油大漲 3.6% ，也使市場對能源價格與通膨風
險的擔憂再度升高。川普先前與俄羅斯達成柴油供應協議，希望增加供
給以壓低燃料價格，但該協議在美國國會面臨跨黨派反對，使市場對後
續供應增加能否順利落實仍存疑慮。個股方面， CoreWeave(CRWV -US)
重挫 11.91% ，公司目前債務規模約 500 億美元，近期部分債券價格大
幅下跌、信用違約交換成本明顯上升，使市場更加擔憂其融資成本與高
度依賴舉債擴張的模式；特斯拉 (TSLA -US)下跌 2.13% ，第二代 Roadster
發表會一度帶動股價走高，但隨科技股賣壓擴大，漲幅全數回吐並轉為
收黑；蘋果 (AAPL -US) 逆勢上漲 0.43% ，首款摺疊手機 iPhone Duo 開放
預購後交貨時間迅速延至明年 1 月底，反映初期需求強勁。
◼ 標普 500 指數 11 個類股中 6 個上漲，其中能源 (+2.47%) 、公用事業
(+1.40%) 、必需性消費 (+1.31%) 表現較好；資訊科技 (-2.54%) 、通訊服
務(-2.45%) 、非必需性消費 (-1.17%) 表現較差。
◼ 美國 9 月進口物價月增率由下修後的 0.5% 升至 1.1% ，高於市場預期的
0.8% ，年增率亦由 6.7% 升至 8.1% ，創 2022 年 7 月以來最大漲幅，顯
示進口端通膨壓力持續升高。細項來看，進口燃料價格月增 4.8% ，排除

已不僅限於能源產品。其中， AI 投資需求帶動電腦、半導體及相關設備

年率由第二季的 5.6% 大幅降至 0.7% ，顯示製造業動能明顯放緩。雖然

產業脈動與個股追蹤
Anthropic 擬籌資 US$60bn 採購 Google TPU 晶片
Anthropic 正透過代號「北極星計畫」 （Project North Star ）的 US$60bn 債務融資，採購 Google (GOOGL US) 開發、
合計約 1.5GW 規模的 TPU 晶片，預計創下歷來最大晶片融資紀錄。黑石旗下基金將提供 US$9bn 次順位貸款，占該
層級融資的一半，並由 Anthropic 未來五年的晶片租金支付本息。
黑石取得的票面利率達 10%，加計折價發行及相關費用後，實際殖利率更高，明顯高於 BB 級美國高收益債約 7%的
水準。高昂融資成本反映投資人對 AI 基礎設施資本支出、信用風險及資金回收能力的疑慮，但市場亦預期 Anthropic
上市並取得投資等級評等後，融資成本有望下降。
AI 基礎設施業者融資成本持續分化， CoreWeave 部分公司債價格跌破面值 80% 、殖利率突破 15% ，凸顯市場對高槓
桿 AI 投資模式的擔憂。相較之下， GMI Cloud 近期取得的新台幣貸款利率僅約 3.45% ，顯示亞洲業者憑藉較低資金
成本及鄰近供應鏈的執行效率，有望在 AI 基礎設施競爭中取得相對優勢。
評論及分析  (鄭傑懋)
Project North Star 以類似 META SPVs 方式債務融資 US$60bn 採購 1.5GW TPU ，Anthropic 透過 5 年的晶片租賃支
付 ， 幾 件 需 要 確 認 的 事 實 ：1) 此 為 媒 體 披 露 非 官 方 正 式 公 告 ；2) 依 照 媒 體 披 露 US$60bn 的 債 務 拆 分 成 70%
US$42bn 的優先級 Broadcom 擔保債務， 30% US$18bn 的無保證人 BB+級債券，其中 Blackstone 承作一半 US$9bn
拿票面利率 10% ，所以非整批皆 10% 借款成本而是其中風險最高的部分； 3) 先前 6 月 Broadcom 推出 AI XPV 平台
借款條件約 US$35bn 5.75% 1GW TPU ，若此次視為先前框架的延伸則平均利率在 7%左右
與我們先前觀點的異同： 1) 若以媒體揭露數字推算相關的建置成本可能在 US$30 -35bn ＋，較我們先前預估 TPU 建置
成本在 US$25 -30bn/GW 高；2) 現在籌資可能相對辛苦的原因呼應凱基美國矽谷參訪紀要第一個重點， 2023-30 AI
週期可以切成 4 個小週期，現在進入第三個週期的前半段，歷經 1H26 3 -4 個月的 AI 滲透率陡升後開始進入冷卻期，
AI 企業付費滲透率每月約增加 0.7ppts vs. 1H26 1.5ppts 減半，我們預期要新的 IT 預算週期啟動 (約 1M27) 方能進入
主要的 Autonomous agents 的主要滲透率推升期，我們相對正向看待 OpenAI 算力主要提供者 MSFT ，以及解決影子
AI 的 Agent 身份驗證管理解決方案如 OKTA, NOW 會持續獲得投資人關注
SpaceX (SPCX US) 斥資近 US$ 8bn 收購無線頻譜
SpaceX (SPCX US) 近期以近 US$ 8bn 收購 Grain 持有的美國  800 MHz 無線頻譜執照，作為發展  Starlink Mobile 行
動通訊服務的重要布局。公司計畫結合低軌衛星與地面基地台，建立涵蓋室內、室外及傳統行動網路訊號死角的混合
式通訊架構。目前  SpaceX 已取得最多部署  15,000 顆 Starlink Mobile 衛星的監管授權，並規劃透過地面通訊塔、屋
頂天線等設備提供服務，顯示其行動通訊策略將不再僅依賴衛星直連手機技術。
然而，Starlink Mobile 若要與 AT&T (T US) 、Verizon (VZ US) 及 T-Mobile (TMUS US) 競爭，仍須投入大量地面網路建
設、客戶服務、手機補貼及行銷支出。 TD Cowen 預估，建立完整行動通訊網路所需投資將超過  US$ 80bn ，且 SpaceX
同時正投入 Starship 、AI 基礎建設及 Terafab 晶片工廠等大型專案，資金需求持續增加。此外，手機天線尺寸與發射功
率有限，加上衛星距離地面數百公里，使衛星直連手機在都市高密度環境下仍面臨訊號品質與網路容量限制。
目前 Starlink 已與 T-Mobile 合作，由後者提供地面網路、 Starlink 補足無基地台覆蓋區域，但  SpaceX 未來可能進一
步自建地面網路，以發展獨立的行動通訊服務。分析師指出， SpaceX 現有頻譜規模仍明顯低於美國三大電信商，雖
足以支援初期業務發展，但若要達到既有業者的網路容量與服務品質，仍需取得更多頻譜並擴大基礎建設。 T-Mobile
與 Verizon 亦認為，僅取得頻譜不足以形成完整競爭力，後續地面網路部署、資本投入及用戶規模將是  Starlink
Mobile 能否擴大市場的重要關鍵。
評論及分析  (張燾)
SpaceX 斥資近 US$ 8bn 收購 800 MHz 無線頻譜，顯示  Starlink 正由衛星寬頻服務商，逐步朝整合衛星與地面網路的
行動通訊業者轉型。相較過去  Starlink 主要服務偏遠地區、填補傳統電信網路覆蓋不足的市場，新策略將進一步切入
既有電信商主導的行動通訊市場，擴大潛在用戶規模。然而，衛星直連手機受限於終端發射功率、頻譜資源及都市建
築物遮蔽，短期仍難以取代地面基地台，因此混合式網路架構將是  SpaceX 提升服務品質與擴大市場覆蓋的重要方向。
凱基認為， Starlink Mobile 最大的財務風險，在於其資本密集程度可能顯著高於既有衛星寬頻業務。 TD Cowen 預估

完整地面行動網路建置成本超過  US$ 80bn ，約為此次頻譜收購金額的  10 倍，且尚須考量用戶取得、手機補貼及營
運支出。相較  SpaceX 可透過  Starship 降低衛星部署成本，地面網路仍須逐區建置基地台、取得站點及完善回傳網
路，難以直接複製衛星業務的成本優勢。若再考量  Starship 、AI 基礎建設及  Terafab 等專案同步推進，未來資本配置
與自由現金流壓力將更加重要。值得注意的是，過去美國三大電信商在截至  2023 年前約 10 年間，對既有網路累計
投入約 US$ 650bn ，反映行動通訊市場不僅進入門檻高，後續亦需要持續投入資本以維持網路競爭力。
SpaceX 短期更合理的策略，是先將衛星直連服務作為既有行動網路的補充，再逐步提高自有地面網路比重，而非立即
複製全國性電信商的營運模式。現有與  T-Mobile 的合作已驗證衛星補足訊號死角的商業應用，但該服務由  T-Mobile
主導用戶關係， SpaceX 若希望直接掌握訂閱收入與定價權，勢必需要建立自己的網路及客戶基礎。另一方面， SpaceX
現有頻譜規模仍低於三大電信商，意味即使取得  15,000 顆衛星部署授權，亦無法直接解決地面頻譜容量不足的問題。
後續觀察重點應聚焦於地面網路建置進度、頻譜取得成本、用戶數與每戶平均收入，而非單純衛星發射數量。
NVIDIA (NVDA US) DLSS 光線重建技術透過非官方模組支援  AMD GPU  (潘俊宏)
NVIDIA (NVDA US) 旗下 DLSS 光線重建（ Ray Reconstruction ）技術近期透過第三方開發者推出的  DLSS -NR-on-AMD
v0.8.0 模組，成功在  AMD (AMD US) Radeon RDNA 3 與 RDNA 4 架構 GPU 上運行。該模組原先主要支援  DLSS 5
Neural Rendering ，目前已擴展至  DLSS Super Resolution 4.5 、Ray Reconstruction 、Frame Generation ，以及最高  4
倍的 Multi Frame Generation 。此項進展使  Radeon GPU 得以透過非官方方式使用原本主要針對  NVIDIA 顯示卡設計
的 AI 圖形處理功能。
技術方面， DLSS Ray Reconstruction 透過 AI 神經網路取代傳統光線追蹤降噪演算法，以改善光線追蹤畫面品質。開
發者表示，該模組並非單純轉譯  NVIDIA 執行指令，而是透過自訂神經網路執行環境，整合  AMD HIP 運算核心、記
憶體配置及遊戲相容機制。社群測試顯示， Radeon RX 9070 XT 搭配 Ryzen 7 9700X ，可於《Cyberpunk 2077 》以
1440p 解析度、最高畫質及  Path Tracing 模式啟用  Ray Reconstruction ，個別測試未觀察到效能下降，但不同硬體與
遊戲配置的實際表現仍存在差異。
最新版本亦導入  NeuralHub 管理介面，簡化  DLSS 函式庫匯入、遊戲偵測及功能設定，主要支援  Windows 11 、AMD
Adrenalin 26.1.1 以上驅動程式及相容  DirectX 12 遊戲，其中  Frame Generation 仍須透過  GPU 識別模擬等額外設定
才能運作。較舊的  RDNA 2 架構目前仍處於實驗性支援階段。儘管相關模組顯示  AI 圖形技術具備跨硬體平台運行的
可能性，但由於屬非官方開發方案，遊戲相容性、畫質穩定性及效能表現尚未獲得全面驗證，亦不代表  NVIDIA 已正
式開放 DLSS 技術支援競爭對手  GPU。
Micron (MU US) 開發結合  HBM 與 LPDDR 的新型記憶體  (沈漢軒)
Micron (MU US) 正開發新型邊緣推論記憶體（ Edge Inference Memory ，EIM ），目標結合  HBM 的高頻寬、低延遲特
性與 LPDDR 的低功耗優勢，滿足未來  AI 機器人即時運算需求。根據韓媒  The Elec 報導，EIM 有望於 2028 年實現商
業化，並可能延伸應用至  LPDDR6 相關記憶體技術。相較傳統  HBM 堆疊架構， EIM 透過將 LPDDR 記憶體堆疊於邏
輯晶片上，尋求在提升資料傳輸效能的同時降低能源消耗，但目前具體運算架構、效能規格及功耗數據尚未公布。
隨 AI 應用由生成式  AI 延伸至實體  AI（Physical AI ），人形機器人將逐步由執行預設動作，轉向整合視覺、聽覺、重
量及材質等感測資訊，自主判斷並執行任務，進一步提高記憶體頻寬、容量及能源效率需求。目前  AI 機器人使用的
模型參數規模約  10–20 億，LPDDR 尚可滿足基本運算需求，但未來隨視覺語言模型及多模態推論複雜度提升，傳統
LPDDR 頻寬可能逐漸成為瓶頸，而  HBM 的功耗特性則可能限制電池供電機器人的持續運作時間。
Micron 此前預估，未來高階  AI 人形機器人的記憶體需求可能提升至  200 GB 以上，並搭配數  TB NAND 儲存容量，
明顯高於現行工業服務機器人約  12 GB 記憶體及  256 GB 儲存容量。 EIM 若能兼顧高頻寬與低功耗，有望成為機器人
端側 AI 推論的重要記憶體解決方案，並帶動記憶體需求由雲端  AI 伺服器進一步擴展至實體  AI 裝置。不過，相關技
術仍處於開發階段，實際量產時程、成本競爭力及終端採用情況仍有待確認。

Microsoft (MSFT US) 退出英國  Nscale 資料中心專案，據報與電力供應延遲有關  (鄭傑懋)
Microsoft (MSFT US) 已終止與英國雲端業者  Nscale 在 Essex Loughton 資料中心的合作協議。 Telegraph 報導指出，
該專案多次延誤，英國國家電網官員曾告知  Nscale ，資料中心可能要到  2030 年代才能取得電力供應。

案，並尋找替代電力來源及其他英國擴建地點。
公司上月已在美國申請  IPO ，招股書顯示  Microsoft 與 Anthropic 預計為主要客戶； Nscale 目前提供算力、電力、資
料中心及  AI 模型訓練與推論相關基礎設施。
CoreWeave (CRWV US) 債券殖利率飆升至  15% (余昀澄)
CoreWeave (CRWV US) 本週債券價格大幅下跌，引發市場對  AI 基礎建設高度依賴舉債擴張的疑慮。公司今年  6 月
發行的債券原始殖利率為  9.675% ，近期隨債券價格下跌，殖利率已攀升至約  15% ，反映投資人要求更高的信用風
險溢酬。 CoreWeave 股價自週一開盤至週四收盤累計下跌  15.1% ，儘管週四受  NVIDIA (NVDA US) 表態支持帶動反
彈 6%，整體表現仍與  Nebius (NBIS US) 、IREN (IREN US) 等新興 AI 雲端業者同步承壓。
相較股價下跌， CoreWeave 債券遭拋售更值得關注，因其可能代表投資人開始重新評估  AI 資料中心融資模式的可持
續性。隨  AI 基礎建設投資規模持續擴大，部分業者由依賴自由現金流轉向大量舉債，面臨融資成本上升、槓桿偏高
及建置週期較長等風險。此外，資料中心可能在正式營運前面臨  GPU 技術迭代與設備貶值壓力，使投資人更加重視
債務擔保條件、現金流回收能力及專案執行進度，未來相關融資成本與審查標準可能進一步提高。
部分債券投資人認為，近期市場反應可能由過度樂觀轉向過度悲觀，但  AI 基礎建設融資環境正進入更重視信用風險
的新階段。除通膨推升資金成本外，資料中心建設亦面臨電力價格、建照審批及地方反對聲浪等限制。科技分析師
Dan Ives 預估，約 5–10% 的規劃中資料中心專案最終可能無法落地。隨  AI 資本支出逐漸由企業內部現金流擴展至
外部債務融資，市場對業者資產負債表、資金取得能力及專案投資報酬率的關注將持續提高。
Anthropic 初階技術人力占比下降， AI 導入後員工會議時間反而增加  (鄭傑懋)
Anthropic 表示，自  2025 年初以來，技術部門初階員工占比由  21% 降至 14% ，初階技術職缺新進人員占比更由
27% 降至 9%。同期間技術團隊占整體員工比重也由  61% 降至 56% ，公司將部分原因歸因於業務部門擴張，以及
非技術員工可透過  coding tools 自行開發軟體。
Anthropic 4 月內部調查顯示， 27% 員工認為  Claude 提升了生產力， 20% 則表示工作內容已轉向管理  Claudes 。公
司報告也指出，隨  Claude 產生大量文字與工作成果， 「人類注意力與判斷」逐漸成為生產力瓶頸。
Anthropic 表示 AI 導入後，每人程式碼產量、每名業務成交量與合約處理量都有提升；但公司也承認更多程式碼不一
定 代表更 高品質 或更大 商業 影響。 另一方 面，每 位員 工的會 議時間 較一年 前增 加  20% ，技 術個人 貢獻者 則增加
16% ，公司將此歸因於人際信任、責任歸屬與面對面協作仍不可取代。
Anthropic 預估 AI 可將美國  GDP 推升至 US$44tn ，並呼籲建立更嚴格  AI 規則 (鄭傑懋)
Anthropic 共同創辦人 Jack Clark 表示，公司內部模型預估，若  AI 技術持續進步，美國  GDP 到 2030 年可能由目前約
US$30tn 增至 US$44tn ，增幅接近 50%。他坦言這項預測「聽起來非常誇張」 ，但認為 AI 正在帶來重大的科學突破。
Clark 表示，若 GDP 真能成長至此規模，依經濟理論必須出現新的產業與發明來支撐這波擴張。他並預期未來幾年不
只 AI，整體科學進展速度也可能加快。
Clark 同時呼籲全球合作建立「非常規且嚴格」的  AI 規則，並表示政策制定者可採取行動的時間有限。他警告， AI
發展可能逐步超出人類控制，未來可能同時帶來巨大財富與重大風險。

WNC (6285.TW): OCS and high-speed switch in expansion; Sep revenues 
+64% YoY; Buy
16 October 2026 | 2:54PM HKT
WNC’s Sep revenues continued to deliver strong growth at 64% YoY (or 2% MoM), 
supported by the ramp up of LEO satellites, WiFi-7 upgrade, and auto connectivity 
business, or 6% below our previous estimates. The company’s 3Q26 revenues were 
up 86% YoY/ 23% MoM to NT$48.7bn, and we expect Oct/ Nov revenues to grow 
66%/ 77% YoY to NT$15.8bn/ NT$14.7bn, while MoM decline on the seasonality. 
The company demonstrated the OCS (Optical Circuit Switching) and 1.6TbE switch 
during the OCP summit 2026, and we are positive on company’s expansion towards 
high-speed products with capabilities to offer total solution. We remain constructive 
on WNC due to (1) LEO user terminal riding on satellite clients’ expansion, (2) wireless 
specification upgrade, and (3) rising spending on the AI infrastructure. Maintain Buy.  
1.6T switch and OCS products in expansion: The company demonstrated its new 
products across the OCS, 800G optical transceiver, and 1.6TbE switch during the 
OCP summit 2026. The new switch enables the 102.4Tbps of switching capacity 
based on 64 units of 1.6TbE NPO ports, supporting the higher bandwidth needs of 
the AI clusters with lower power consumption. On OCS, the company highlights its 
high compatibility to support different generation of the Ethernet networks with 
lower deployment cost.

Earnings revision: We factor in WNC 2Q26 result and revise up earnings by 1%/ 2%/ 2% 
in 2026-28E to reflect higher than expected revenues of WiFi 7/ WiFi 8 and switch 
products, driven by spec upgrade and rising client demand. We keep GM and Opex ratio 
largely unchanged.  
 
Valuation: With the earning estimate changes, we raise our 12M TP to NT$380.0 (vs. 
previously at NT$371, based on 28.0x 2027E P/E, unchanged). We continue to base 
our TP on 2027E P/E, and the target multiple is still derived from the correlation 
between P/E and EPS growth of its peers, which is higher as we mark to market. Our 
target P/E of 28.0x is higher than company’s avg. +1 std P/E (16.3x), which we believe is 
not stretched considering the sustainable growth of WNC driven by long-term satellite 
and high speed networking demand. Maintain Buy.

GS Factor Profile 
The Goldman Sachs Factor Profile provides investment context for a stock by comparing key attributes to the market (i.e. our universe of rated stocks) 
and its sector peers. The four key attributes depicted are: Growth, Financial Returns, Multiple (e.g. valuation) and Integrated (a composite of Growth, 
Financial Returns and Multiple). Growth, Financial Returns and Multiple are calculated by using normalized ranks for specific metrics for each stock. The 
normalized ranks for the metrics are then averaged and converted into percentiles for the relevant attribute. The precise calculation of each metric may 
vary depending on the fiscal year, industry and region, but the standard approach is as follows: 
Growth is based on a stock’s forward-looking sales growth, EBITDA growth and EPS growth (for financial stocks, only EPS and sales growth), with a 
higher percentile indicating a higher growth company. Financial Returns is based on a stock’s forward-looking ROE, ROCE and CROCI (for financial 
stocks, only ROE), with a higher percentile indicating a company with higher financial returns. Multiple is based on a stock’s forward-looking P/E, P/B, 
price/dividend (P/D), EV/EBITDA, EV/FCF and EV/Debt Adjusted Cash Flow (DACF) (for financial stocks, only P/E, P/B and P/D), with a higher percentile 
indicating a stock trading at a higher multiple. The Integrated percentile is calculated as the average of the Growth percentile, Financial Returns 
percentile and (100% - Multiple percentile). 
Financial Returns and Multiple use the Goldman Sachs analyst forecasts at the fiscal year-end at least three quarters in the future. Growth uses inputs 
for the fiscal year at least seven quarters in the future compared with the year at least three quarters in the future (on a per-share basis for all metrics). 
For a more detailed description of how we calculate the GS Factor Profile, please contact your GS representative.  
M&A Rank 
Across our global coverage, we examine stocks using an M&A framework, considering both qualitative factors and quantitative factors (which may vary 
across sectors and regions) to incorporate the potential that certain companies could be acquired. We then assign a M&A rank as a means of scoring 
companies under our rated coverage from 1 to 3, with 1 representing high (30%-50%) probability of the company becoming an acquisition target, 2 
representing medium (15%-30%) probability and 3 representing low (0%-15%) probability. For companies ranked 1 or 2, in line with our standard 
departmental guidelines we incorporate an M&A component into our target price. M&A rank of 3 is considered immaterial and therefore does not 
factor into our price target, and may or may not be discussed in research.

WNC (6285.TW): OCS and high-speed switch in expansion; Sep revenues
+64% YoY; Buy
16 October 2026 | 2:54PM HKT
WNC’s Sep revenues continued to deliver strong growth at 64% YoY (or 2% MoM),
supported by the ramp up of LEO satellites, WiFi-7 upgrade, and auto connectivity
business, or 6% below our previous estimates. The company’s 3Q26 revenues were
up 86% YoY/ 23% MoM to NT$48.7bn, and we expect Oct/ Nov revenues to grow
66%/ 77% YoY to NT$15.8bn/ NT$14.7bn, while MoM decline on the seasonality.
The company demonstrated the OCS (Optical Circuit Switching) and 1.6TbE switch
during the OCP summit 2026, and we are positive on company’s expansion towards
high-speed products with capabilities to offer total solution. We remain constructive
on WNC due to (1) LEO user terminal riding on satellite clients’ expansion, (2) wireless
specification upgrade, and (3) rising spending on the AI infrastructure. Maintain Buy.
1.6T switch and OCS products in expansion: The company demonstrated its new
products across the OCS, 800G optical transceiver, and 1.6TbE switch during the
OCP summit 2026. The new switch enables the 102.4Tbps of switching capacity
based on 64 units of 1.6TbE NPO ports, supporting the higher bandwidth needs of
the AI clusters with lower power consumption. On OCS, the company highlights its
high compatibility to support different generation of the Ethernet networks with
lower deployment cost.

Earnings revision: We factor in WNC 2Q26 result and revise up earnings by 1%/ 2%/ 2%
in 2026-28E to reflect higher than expected revenues of WiFi 7/ WiFi 8 and switch
products, driven by spec upgrade and rising client demand. We keep GM and Opex ratio
largely unchanged.

Valuation: With the earning estimate changes, we raise our 12M TP to NT$380.0 (vs.
previously at NT$371, based on 28.0x 2027E P/E, unchanged). We continue to base
our TP on 2027E P/E, and the target multiple is still derived from the correlation
between P/E and EPS growth of its peers, which is higher as we mark to market. Our
target P/E of 28.0x is higher than company’s avg. +1 std P/E (16.3x), which we believe is
not stretched considering the sustainable growth of WNC driven by long-term satellite
and high speed networking demand. Maintain Buy.

GS Factor Profile
The Goldman Sachs Factor Profile provides investment context for a stock by comparing key attributes to the market (i.e. our universe of rated stocks)
and its sector peers. The four key attributes depicted are: Growth, Financial Returns, Multiple (e.g. valuation) and Integrated (a composite of Growth,
Financial Returns and Multiple). Growth, Financial Returns and Multiple are calculated by using normalized ranks for specific metrics for each stock. The
normalized ranks for the metrics are then averaged and converted into percentiles for the relevant attribute. The precise calculation of each metric may
vary depending on the fiscal year, industry and region, but the standard approach is as follows:
Growth is based on a stock’s forward-looking sales growth, EBITDA growth and EPS growth (for financial stocks, only EPS and sales growth), with a
higher percentile indicating a higher growth company. Financial Returns is based on a stock’s forward-looking ROE, ROCE and CROCI (for financial
stocks, only ROE), with a higher percentile indicating a company with higher financial returns. Multiple is based on a stock’s forward-looking P/E, P/B,
price/dividend (P/D), EV/EBITDA, EV/FCF and EV/Debt Adjusted Cash Flow (DACF) (for financial stocks, only P/E, P/B and P/D), with a higher percentile
indicating a stock trading at a higher multiple. The Integrated percentile is calculated as the average of the Growth percentile, Financial Returns
percentile and (100% - Multiple percentile).
Financial Returns and Multiple use the Goldman Sachs analyst forecasts at the fiscal year-end at least three quarters in the future. Growth uses inputs
for the fiscal year at least seven quarters in the future compared with the year at least three quarters in the future (on a per-share basis for all metrics).
For a more detailed description of how we calculate the GS Factor Profile, please contact your GS representative.
M&A Rank

across sectors and regions) to incorporate the potential that certain companies could be acquired. We then assign a M&A rank as a means of scoring
companies under our rated coverage from 1 to 3, with 1 representing high (30%-50%) probability of the company becoming an acquisition target, 2
representing medium (15%-30%) probability and 3 representing low (0%-15%) probability. For companies ranked 1 or 2, in line with our standard
departmental guidelines we incorporate an M&A component into our target price. M&A rank of 3 is considered immaterial and therefore does not

大和證券（Daiwa Capital Markets）欣銓（Ardentec, 3264）2026-10-16

評等與目標價：維持欣銓（Ardentec, 3264.TWO）「買進（1）」，目標價從 340 元上調到 395 元，以 10/15 股價 268 元計算，潛在漲幅 47.4%。評價基礎是 2027 年 EPS 的 25 倍本益比，高於封測同業平均，報告認為高速 AI 連接需求和龍潭廠放量撐得起這個溢價。

淡季不淡：原本預期 4Q26 到 1Q27 會碰到傳統淡季，現在改成逆季節成長，主因是 1.6T 網通加速普及，測試供應鏈的網通需求暴增。4Q26 營收預估 55.08 億元，1Q27 預估 57.73 億元，持續季增。

AI 占比提前拉高：AI 營收（含 AI 連接）占比預計在 1Q27 超過 40%，比原本預期早很多。

毛利率上行：高速網通案大多採客戶代工模式，營收占比提高會推升毛利率。2027 年毛利率預估從 44.5% 上修到 46.6%，營業利益率從 35.3% 上修到 37.4%。

CPO 測試：子公司全智科技已通過美國一線大廠認證並開始放量，目前集中在第一道測試站，未來有機會分散客戶，並擴展到第二、第三道測試站。

產能：龍潭廠二、三樓無塵室預計 2026 年底完工，二樓產能 1Q27 末開始貢獻。報告假設測試機台從 2025 年的 1,879 台增加到 2028 年的 2,523 台，稼動率從 63% 升到 83%，每小時費率從 1,343 元升到 1,904 元。

風險：報告列出的主要下行風險是擴產延遲。

Industry View Attractive
ICA/IPO: Gaining traction, but cost still a hurdle. A China CSP outlined optical 
form factors from XPO/NPO to interposer optics (IPO) and CPO, including 
integration of IPO with interposer copper attach (ICA). TE Connectivity showcased 
224G/448G NPO/CPO sockets and ICA sockets with 0.4mm pitch and up to 10,000 
pins, offering high-density connectivity, low crosstalk and improved reworkability. 
We see rising traction for ICA/IPO, with potential mass production in 2027   (For 
more, see our recent CPO report). 
Marvell IMC: Complementary to AST2700, not a replacement. Marvell 
demonstrated the OCTEON-based infrastructure management controller (IMC) 
addresses higher-level Al rack/cluster telemetry and control; ASPEED's AST2700 
BMC continues to handle node-level security and remote management. Given 
distinct functions and software ecosystems, we do not view IMC as a direct 
AST2700 competitor. We also don't see an AST2700 production issue, supporting 
an on-track ramp. The key debate is actually market share in TPU/Axion.
Caliptra: Expanding hardware Root of Trust opportunities. The open Caliptra 
framework defines silicon-level Root of trust (RoT) for data-center processors and 
accelerators, supporting secure boot, device identity and attestation eMemory 
(3529.TW) subsidiary PUFsecurity offers PUFrt, providing NeoPUF-derived device, 
NeoFuse OTP secure storage and hardware entropy as physical security building 
blocks for Caliptra implementations. Broader adoption could support incremental 
PUF/security-IP licensing, although monetization depends on qualifications and 
customer design wins. (For more, see our quantum security report).
Other: CXL fabric, cooling and compute ramps: The microchannel lid 
demonstration underscored the importance of chip-level thermal design as rack

Industry View Attractive
ICA/IPO: Gaining traction, but cost still a hurdle. A China CSP outlined optical
form factors from XPO/NPO to interposer optics (IPO) and CPO, including
integration of IPO with interposer copper attach (ICA). TE Connectivity showcased
224G/448G NPO/CPO sockets and ICA sockets with 0.4mm pitch and up to 10,000
pins, offering high-density connectivity, low crosstalk and improved reworkability.
We see rising traction for ICA/IPO, with potential mass production in 2027   (For
more, see our recent CPO report).
Marvell IMC: Complementary to AST2700, not a replacement. Marvell
demonstrated the OCTEON-based infrastructure management controller (IMC)
addresses higher-level Al rack/cluster telemetry and control; ASPEED's AST2700
BMC continues to handle node-level security and remote management. Given
distinct functions and software ecosystems, we do not view IMC as a direct
AST2700 competitor. We also don't see an AST2700 production issue, supporting
an on-track ramp. The key debate is actually market share in TPU/Axion.
Caliptra: Expanding hardware Root of Trust opportunities. The open Caliptra
framework defines silicon-level Root of trust (RoT) for data-center processors and
accelerators, supporting secure boot, device identity and attestation eMemory
(3529.TW) subsidiary PUFsecurity offers PUFrt, providing NeoPUF-derived device,
NeoFuse OTP secure storage and hardware entropy as physical security building
blocks for Caliptra implementations. Broader adoption could support incremental
PUF/security-IP licensing, although monetization depends on qualifications and
customer design wins. (For more, see our quantum security report).
Other: CXL fabric, cooling and compute ramps: The microchannel lid
demonstration underscored the importance of chip-level thermal design as rack

(emoji)GS_啟碁(6285, Buy, TP$371上調至$380)
 
(emoji)啟碁9月營收年增64%、月增2%，主要受低軌衛星、WiFi 7升級及車用連網業務放量帶動，但仍較原先預估低6%。3Q26營收達487億元，年增86%、季增23%；預估10月及11月營收分別為158億元及147億元，年增66%及77%，惟受季節性因素影響，月營收可能下滑。
 
(emoji)公司於2026年OCP高峰會展示光路交換（OCS）、800G光收發器及1.6TbE交換器等新產品，其中1.6TbE交換器採用64個1.6TbE NPO連接埠，交換容量達102.4Tbps，可滿足AI運算叢集對高頻寬及低功耗的需求；OCS則具備支援不同世代乙太網路的相容性，有助降低部署成本。
 
(emoji)隨著WiFi 7、WiFi 8及交換器產品需求優於預期，將2026至2028年每股盈餘預估分別上調1%、2%及2%，毛利率與營業費用率預估則大致維持不變。
 
(emoji)估2026/2027/2028年EPS 13.04/13.56/17.15（原估12.96/13.26/16.85元）。

AVC (3017.TW): Liquid cooling rising penetration and AI servers ramp-up 
to drive growth ahead; Buy
19 October 2026 | 3:24AM HKT
3-month revenues preview: We expect AVC’s monthly revenues to continue 
sequential growth through Dec 2026, leading 4Q26 revenues to grow at +42% YoY/ 
+15% QoQ, driven by: (1) new AI server racks ramp-up, driving the overall liquid 
cooling penetration rate. As we highlighted in Oct (report link), we expect AI server 
rack (NVL72-equivalent) shipment (incl. Nvidia and AMD) to reach 63k/ 110k/ 164k 
in 2026-28E, reflecting our positive view on AI server racks. (2) Its major ASIC AI 
server customer’s new model ramp-up, driving its air-cooling and liquid-cooling 
components, along with a rising liquid cooling penetration rate. (3) Its customer base 
expansion to a new ASIC AI server, to further drive its liquid cooling components in 
4Q26. And (4) increasing adoption rate of ultra-thin VC in consumer electronics to fit 
the lightweight design and major customer’s foldable phone model. We expect AVC’s 
net income to grow at a +39% CAGR in 2026-28E, riding on the strong AI spending, a 
growing liquid cooling penetration rate, and AVC’s leading market position in total 
solutions (air cooling, liquid cooling with various components / systems). Maintain 
Buy.

Earnings revisions: We factor in AVC’s Sep revenue and revise down our 2026E net 
income by -1%, mainly on lower revenues in 4Q26E, reflecting the slow consumer 
electronics under high memory costs and AI servers model transition. We revise up our 
2027-28E net income by 4% / 0%, mainly on higher revenues and GMs. Our 2027-28E 
revenue is revised up by 1% / 1%, mainly on a higher contribution from AI server liquid 
cooling components. 2027-28E GM are revised up to reflect the rising liquid cooling 
components driving profitability.  
 
 
Valuation: We continue to use a near-term P/E to derive our 12-month target price and 
update our target P/E multiple to 30.6x 2027E EPS (vs. 30.3x previously), which is still 
derived from PC/server peers’ EPS growth vs. P/E multiple correlation. Our target P/E 
multiple is above AVC’s historical average +1stv. forward trading P/E, reflecting our 
positive view on AVC riding on the rising penetration rate of liquid-cooled AI servers. 
With our updated target P/E and earnings estimates, we raise our 12-month target price 
to NT$4,736 (from NT$4,513). Maintain Buy.

Price Target Risks and Methodology - AVC 
We are Buy-rated on AVC. Our 12-month target price for AVC is based on a near-term 
P/E, consistent with our Taiwan Technology coverage. We base our target price of 
NT$4,736 on a target P/E multiple of 30.6x applied to our forward-year EPS (2027E). 
Our target P/E is derived from the correlation between P/E and EPS growth of its peers 
in technology hardware.  
Key downside risks: (1) slower-than-expected adoption of liquid cooling; (2) 
lower-than-expected demand for AI servers; (3) fiercer-than-expected competition; 
and (4) a slower-than-expected recovery in general servers.

The Goldman Sachs Factor Profile provides investment context for a stock by comparing key attributes to the market (i.e. our universe of rated stocks)

Growth is based on a stock’s forward-looking sales growth, EBITDA growth and EPS growth (for financial stocks, only EPS and sales growth), with a 
higher percentile indicating a higher growth company. Financial Returns is based on a stock’s forward-looking ROE, ROCE and CROCI (for financial 
stocks, only ROE), with a higher percentile indicating a company with higher financial returns. Multiple is based on a stock’s forward-looking P/E, P/B,

percentile and (100% - Multiple percentile).

AVC (3017.TW): Liquid cooling rising penetration and AI servers ramp-up
to drive growth ahead; Buy
19 October 2026 | 3:24AM HKT
3-month revenues preview: We expect AVC’s monthly revenues to continue
sequential growth through Dec 2026, leading 4Q26 revenues to grow at +42% YoY/
+15% QoQ, driven by: (1) new AI server racks ramp-up, driving the overall liquid
cooling penetration rate. As we highlighted in Oct (report link), we expect AI server
rack (NVL72-equivalent) shipment (incl. Nvidia and AMD) to reach 63k/ 110k/ 164k
in 2026-28E, reflecting our positive view on AI server racks. (2) Its major ASIC AI
server customer’s new model ramp-up, driving its air-cooling and liquid-cooling
components, along with a rising liquid cooling penetration rate. (3) Its customer base
expansion to a new ASIC AI server, to further drive its liquid cooling components in
4Q26. And (4) increasing adoption rate of ultra-thin VC in consumer electronics to fit
the lightweight design and major customer’s foldable phone model. We expect AVC’s
net income to grow at a +39% CAGR in 2026-28E, riding on the strong AI spending, a
growing liquid cooling penetration rate, and AVC’s leading market position in total
solutions (air cooling, liquid cooling with various components / systems). Maintain
Buy.

Earnings revisions: We factor in AVC’s Sep revenue and revise down our 2026E net
income by -1%, mainly on lower revenues in 4Q26E, reflecting the slow consumer
electronics under high memory costs and AI servers model transition. We revise up our
2027-28E net income by 4% / 0%, mainly on higher revenues and GMs. Our 2027-28E
revenue is revised up by 1% / 1%, mainly on a higher contribution from AI server liquid
cooling components. 2027-28E GM are revised up to reflect the rising liquid cooling
components driving profitability.

Valuation: We continue to use a near-term P/E to derive our 12-month target price and
update our target P/E multiple to 30.6x 2027E EPS (vs. 30.3x previously), which is still
derived from PC/server peers’ EPS growth vs. P/E multiple correlation. Our target P/E
multiple is above AVC’s historical average +1stv. forward trading P/E, reflecting our
positive view on AVC riding on the rising penetration rate of liquid-cooled AI servers.
With our updated target P/E and earnings estimates, we raise our 12-month target price
to NT$4,736 (from NT$4,513). Maintain Buy.

Price Target Risks and Methodology - AVC
We are Buy-rated on AVC. Our 12-month target price for AVC is based on a near-term
P/E, consistent with our Taiwan Technology coverage. We base our target price of
NT$4,736 on a target P/E multiple of 30.6x applied to our forward-year EPS (2027E).
Our target P/E is derived from the correlation between P/E and EPS growth of its peers
in technology hardware.
Key downside risks: (1) slower-than-expected adoption of liquid cooling; (2)
lower-than-expected demand for AI servers; (3) fiercer-than-expected competition;
and (4) a slower-than-expected recovery in general servers.

GS Factor Profile
The Goldman Sachs Factor Profile provides investment context for a stock by comparing key attributes to the market (i.e. our universe of rated stocks)
and its sector peers. The four key attributes depicted are: Growth, Financial Returns, Multiple (e.g. valuation) and Integrated (a composite of Growth,
Financial Returns and Multiple). Growth, Financial Returns and Multiple are calculated by using normalized ranks for specific metrics for each stock. The
normalized ranks for the metrics are then averaged and converted into percentiles for the relevant attribute. The precise calculation of each metric may
vary depending on the fiscal year, industry and region, but the standard approach is as follows:
Growth is based on a stock’s forward-looking sales growth, EBITDA growth and EPS growth (for financial stocks, only EPS and sales growth), with a
higher percentile indicating a higher growth company. Financial Returns is based on a stock’s forward-looking ROE, ROCE and CROCI (for financial
stocks, only ROE), with a higher percentile indicating a company with higher financial returns. Multiple is based on a stock’s forward-looking P/E, P/B,
price/dividend (P/D), EV/EBITDA, EV/FCF and EV/Debt Adjusted Cash Flow (DACF) (for financial stocks, only P/E, P/B and P/D), with a higher percentile
indicating a stock trading at a higher multiple. The Integrated percentile is calculated as the average of the Growth percentile, Financial Returns
percentile and (100% - Multiple percentile).
Financial Returns and Multiple use the Goldman Sachs analyst forecasts at the fiscal year-end at least three quarters in the future. Growth uses inputs
for the fiscal year at least seven quarters in the future compared with the year at least three quarters in the future (on a per-share basis for all metrics).
For a more detailed description of how we calculate the GS Factor Profile, please contact your GS representative.
M&A Rank
Across our global coverage, we examine stocks using an M&A framework, considering both qualitative factors and quantitative factors (which may vary
across sectors and regions) to incorporate the potential that certain companies could be acquired. We then assign a M&A rank as a means of scoring
companies under our rated coverage from 1 to 3, with 1 representing high (30%-50%) probability of the company becoming an acquisition target, 2
representing medium (15%-30%) probability and 3 representing low (0%-15%) probability. For companies ranked 1 or 2, in line with our standard
departmental guidelines we incorporate an M&A component into our target price. M&A rank of 3 is considered immaterial and therefore does not
factor into our price target, and may or may not be discussed in research.

Quantum is Goldman Sachs’ proprietary database providing access to detailed financial statement histories, forecasts and ratios. It can be used for
in-depth analysis of a single company, or to make comparisons between companies in different sectors and markets.

將延續。4.台幣近期趨貶，外資也大幅減碼台股，加上融資餘額居高不下，籌碼面不利於多方表
現。5.本周觀察:中國GDP、美科技股財報與TPCA展、台股法說會等。

Quanta (2382.TW): AI servers ramp up to drive growth ahead; model 
transition and PC shipment slowdown could weigh on 4Q26; Neutral
19 October 2026 | 1:57AM HKT
Quanta Sep revenues declined by 23% MoM, which we attributed to AI servers model 
transition, while PC entering quarter-end at strong MoM of +62% MoM. Looking 
forward, we expect monthly revenues to resume sequential growth in Oct to Dec, 
riding on reducing impact of AI servers model transition as new racks ramping up, 
along with growing general servers on agentic AI, and ASP increase on better 
specification and high raw material costs. We expect 4Q26E revenues to decline by 
4% QoQ, considering the high base in 3Q26 and the gradual ramp up of new AI 
server racks. As we highlighted in Oct (Global Server TAM updates), we expect global 
AI server racks (powered by NVIDIA and AMD) shipment at 63k / 110k / 164k in 
2026E-28E along with the specification upgrade to drive the ASP; we raised leading 
US CSPs in aggregate capex by 4% / 17% / 22% in 2026E-28E to US$1,397bn by 
2028E, reflecting our positive view on AI spending. Maintain Neutral on fair 
valuation.

GS Factor Profile 
The Goldman Sachs Factor Profile provides investment context for a stock by comparing key attributes to the market (i.e. our universe of rated stocks) 
and its sector peers. The four key attributes depicted are: Growth, Financial Returns, Multiple (e.g. valuation) and Integrated (a composite of Growth, 
Financial Returns and Multiple). Growth, Financial Returns and Multiple are calculated by using normalized ranks for specific metrics for each stock. The 
normalized ranks for the metrics are then averaged and converted into percentiles for the relevant attribute. The precise calculation of each metric may 
vary depending on the fiscal year, industry and region, but the standard approach is as follows: 
Growth is based on a stock’s forward-looking sales growth, EBITDA growth and EPS growth (for financial stocks, only EPS and sales growth), with a 
higher percentile indicating a higher growth company. Financial Returns is based on a stock’s forward-looking ROE, ROCE and CROCI (for financial 
stocks, only ROE), with a higher percentile indicating a company with higher financial returns. Multiple is based on a stock’s forward-looking P/E, P/B, 
price/dividend (P/D), EV/EBITDA, EV/FCF and EV/Debt Adjusted Cash Flow (DACF) (for financial stocks, only P/E, P/B and P/D), with a higher percentile 
indicating a stock trading at a higher multiple. The Integrated percentile is calculated as the average of the Growth percentile, Financial Returns 
percentile and (100% - Multiple percentile). 
Financial Returns and Multiple use the Goldman Sachs analyst forecasts at the fiscal year-end at least three quarters in the future. Growth uses inputs 
for the fiscal year at least seven quarters in the future compared with the year at least three quarters in the future (on a per-share basis for all metrics). 
For a more detailed description of how we calculate the GS Factor Profile, please contact your GS representative.  
M&A Rank 
Across our global coverage, we examine stocks using an M&A framework, considering both qualitative factors and quantitative factors (which may vary 
across sectors and regions) to incorporate the potential that certain companies could be acquired. We then assign a M&A rank as a means of scoring 
companies under our rated coverage from 1 to 3, with 1 representing high (30%-50%) probability of the company becoming an acquisition target, 2 
representing medium (15%-30%) probability and 3 representing low (0%-15%) probability. For companies ranked 1 or 2, in line with our standard 
departmental guidelines we incorporate an M&A component into our target price. M&A rank of 3 is considered immaterial and therefore does not 
factor into our price target, and may or may not be discussed in research.

Quanta (2382.TW): AI servers ramp up to drive growth ahead; model
transition and PC shipment slowdown could weigh on 4Q26; Neutral
19 October 2026 | 1:57AM HKT
Quanta Sep revenues declined by 23% MoM, which we attributed to AI servers model
transition, while PC entering quarter-end at strong MoM of +62% MoM. Looking
forward, we expect monthly revenues to resume sequential growth in Oct to Dec,
riding on reducing impact of AI servers model transition as new racks ramping up,
along with growing general servers on agentic AI, and ASP increase on better
specification and high raw material costs. We expect 4Q26E revenues to decline by
4% QoQ, considering the high base in 3Q26 and the gradual ramp up of new AI
server racks. As we highlighted in Oct (Global Server TAM updates), we expect global
AI server racks (powered by NVIDIA and AMD) shipment at 63k / 110k / 164k in
2026E-28E along with the specification upgrade to drive the ASP; we raised leading
US CSPs in aggregate capex by 4% / 17% / 22% in 2026E-28E to US$1,397bn by
2028E, reflecting our positive view on AI spending. Maintain Neutral on fair
valuation.

Earnings revision: We raise revenues by 1% / 23% / 30% in 2026E-28E to reflect the
AI server racks shipment ramp up and higher ASP on better specification. Given the

GS Factor Profile
The Goldman Sachs Factor Profile provides investment context for a stock by comparing key attributes to the market (i.e. our universe of rated stocks)
and its sector peers. The four key attributes depicted are: Growth, Financial Returns, Multiple (e.g. valuation) and Integrated (a composite of Growth,
Financial Returns and Multiple). Growth, Financial Returns and Multiple are calculated by using normalized ranks for specific metrics for each stock. The
normalized ranks for the metrics are then averaged and converted into percentiles for the relevant attribute. The precise calculation of each metric may
vary depending on the fiscal year, industry and region, but the standard approach is as follows:
Growth is based on a stock’s forward-looking sales growth, EBITDA growth and EPS growth (for financial stocks, only EPS and sales growth), with a
higher percentile indicating a higher growth company. Financial Returns is based on a stock’s forward-looking ROE, ROCE and CROCI (for financial
stocks, only ROE), with a higher percentile indicating a company with higher financial returns. Multiple is based on a stock’s forward-looking P/E, P/B,
price/dividend (P/D), EV/EBITDA, EV/FCF and EV/Debt Adjusted Cash Flow (DACF) (for financial stocks, only P/E, P/B and P/D), with a higher percentile
indicating a stock trading at a higher multiple. The Integrated percentile is calculated as the average of the Growth percentile, Financial Returns
percentile and (100% - Multiple percentile).
Financial Returns and Multiple use the Goldman Sachs analyst forecasts at the fiscal year-end at least three quarters in the future. Growth uses inputs
for the fiscal year at least seven quarters in the future compared with the year at least three quarters in the future (on a per-share basis for all metrics).
For a more detailed description of how we calculate the GS Factor Profile, please contact your GS representative.
M&A Rank
Across our global coverage, we examine stocks using an M&A framework, considering both qualitative factors and quantitative factors (which may vary
across sectors and regions) to incorporate the potential that certain companies could be acquired. We then assign a M&A rank as a means of scoring
companies under our rated coverage from 1 to 3, with 1 representing high (30%-50%) probability of the company becoming an acquisition target, 2
representing medium (15%-30%) probability and 3 representing low (0%-15%) probability. For companies ranked 1 or 2, in line with our standard
departmental guidelines we incorporate an M&A component into our target price. M&A rank of 3 is considered immaterial and therefore does not
factor into our price target, and may or may not be discussed in research.

【Raw_Inbox row21964】
日東紡首度明說 T glass share 會隨台廠進場而略降，但靠載板核心層加厚、CPU/ASIC 顆數增加與 Vlex/石英級新規格，單價和金額還是能上

“ - 日東紡是高階玻纖布的全球第一供應商，產品用於高性能半導體封裝載板與電子設備主機板；在特殊玻璃（NE／T glass 等）掌握業界事實標準，份額壓倒性領先。
- AI GPU 急速放量，帶動抗翹曲的 T 玻璃需求暴增，供給持續吃緊。
目前市況
- AI 伺服器市場依舊旺盛，GPU／CPU 用的低熱膨脹（低 CTE）T glass，以及高速訊號用的低介電／低損耗 NE／NER 玻璃，需求都處於極佳狀態。
- 供給非常緊，公司每天都在設法提升良率、多擠出一點出貨。
T glass 的區域需求
- 以直接客戶（CCL 銅箔基板廠）來看，薄型 FCCSP 與 FCBGA 的 CCL 基材長期由日系廠商主導；記憶體與模組用 CSP 則韓系也很強。
國內外投資進度
- 按計畫推進。原絲（紗）擴產以台灣為中心增設熔爐，T glass 紗正在內部評估，2027 年度以後開始貢獻量產，希望盡量提前出貨。
- 日本國內為了拉高特殊玻璃供給能力，已提出把 E glass 熔爐廢爐的計畫；騰出來後生產什麼會看市況決定。
- 玻纖布同步增產，織布工程將與南亞塑膠協作。
- 需求強到一年前聽到的數字不斷上修，因此把到 2027 年度的投資上調 400 億日圓至 1,200 億日圓，T glass 產能目標為 2025 年度的 3 倍。
競爭對手正式進入
- 公司知道 T glass 出現競爭者；市場急速擴大，份額未來可能略降，但金額規模會持續向上。
- 2027 年度起拉高供給量。30 年以上穩定品質的供貨紀錄是主要差異化，公司堅持「日東紡品質」。
若需求持續再升
- 推論用 AI 需求點火，CPU 顆數看起來會比以往多；除了既有半導體廠的交換器與 GPU 元件，雲端服務商的自研 ASIC 與 CPU 也在增加。
- 出現載板大尺寸化與核心層多層化需求，核心層厚度將從現狀倍增到 2.4～3 mm。
- 特殊玻璃的旺盛需求短期內會延續；從客戶長期預測看，持續資本支出不可或缺，公司正細審 2029～2030 年度的需求，評估下一輪投資。
下世代產品
- 資料中心主機板對特殊玻璃的要求也在拉高，為對應高頻需要更好的電氣特性，公司推薦 Low-Dk／Df 優異的 NER／NEZ，部分產品已量產。
- 下下世代「DXⅡ」屬石英玻璃等級，目標 2028 年度送樣。
- T glass的下世代品「Vlex」開發中，在低 CTE 之外加入低損耗等電氣特性，預計 2028 年前後正式出貨。
- 基板材料特性由玻纖布單獨決定不了，與新樹脂的搭配和基板設計思想同樣關鍵。未來重點是把現有增產計畫落實，並透過對半導體廠與載板廠的行銷、與 CCL 廠的協作，供應高附加價值產品。”

- 以直接客戶（CCL 銅箔基板廠）來看，薄型 FCCSP 與 FCBGA 的 CCL 基材長期由日系廠商主導；記憶體與模組用 CSP 則韓系也很強。
國內外投資進度
- 按計畫推進。原絲（紗）擴產以台灣為中心增設熔爐，T glass 紗正在內部評估，2027 年度以後開始貢獻量產，希望盡量提前出貨。
- 日本國內為了拉高特殊玻璃供給能力，已提出把 E glass 熔爐廢爐的計畫；騰出來後生產什麼會看市況決定。
- 玻纖布同步增產，織布工程將與南亞塑膠協作。
- 需求強到一年前聽到的數字不斷上修，因此把到 2027 年度的投資上調 400 億日圓至 1,200 億日圓，T glass 產能目標為 2025 年度的 3 倍。
競爭對手正式進入
- 公司知道 T glass 出現競爭者；市場急速擴大，份額未來可能略降，但金額規模會持續向上。
- 2027 年度起拉高供給量。30 年以上穩定品質的供貨紀錄是主要差異化，公司堅持「日東紡品質」。
若需求持續再升
- 推論用 AI 需求點火，CPU 顆數看起來會比以往多；除了既有半導體廠的交換器與 GPU 元件，雲端服務商的自研 ASIC 與 CPU 也在增加。
- 出現載板大尺寸化與核心層多層化需求，核心層厚度將從現狀倍增到 2.4～3 mm。
- 特殊玻璃的旺盛需求短期內會延續；從客戶長期預測看，持續資本支出不可或缺，公司正細審 2029～2030 年度的需求，評估下一輪投資。
下世代產品
- 資料中心主機板對特殊玻璃的要求也在拉高，為對應高頻需要更好的電氣特性，公司推薦 Low-Dk／Df 優異的 NER／NEZ，部分產品已量產。
- 下下世代「DXⅡ」屬石英玻璃等級，目標 2028 年度送樣。
- T glass的下世代品「Vlex」開發中，在低 CTE 之外加入低損耗等電氣特性，預計 2028 年前後正式出貨。
- 基板材料特性由玻纖布單獨決定不了，與新樹脂的搭配和基板設計思想同樣關鍵。未來重點是把現有增產計畫落實，並透過對半導體廠與載板廠的行銷、與 CCL 廠的協作，供應高附加價值產品。”

items.full_text:

https://x.com/QQ_Timmy/status/2112142999513911381  讚 28 / 瀏覽 3805

TSMC熊本第2工廠改產3nm（經產省認定）

認定日期：2026年10月16日，經濟產業省正式認定JASM熊本第2工廠生產計畫變更。
主要變更：從原本6nm／12nm（＋部分40nm）改為專產3nm邏輯半導體。
產能：初期月產6,000片（300mm晶圓），遠低於原計畫的約4.8萬片。
量產時程：預計2028年12月前開始生產（2028年Q4首次出貨），並計畫持續生產10年以上。
交貨對象：以日本客戶為主。
變更原因：因應AI快速發展帶來的市場需求變化，轉向更先進的3nm製程。
投資與補助：
  - 設備投資從122億美元調降至108億美元。
  - 日本政府最大補助額從7,320億日圓調降至6,451.5億日圓。
  - 但日經等報導指出，總投資額可能擴大至至少157億美元；最終產能視政府補助金額而定。
第1工廠同步調整：放棄12／16nm，改以22／28nm為主（＋部分40nm），月產能從5.5萬片調降至5萬片，設備投資從86億美元降至73億美元。
背景確認：2026年2月C.C. Wei訪日時提出，近期財報會重申計畫順利、預計2028年量產。
https://eetimes.itmedia.co.jp/ee/articles/2610/19/news041.html

【引用原文 @TSMCinJapan】
JASM第二工場の計画に対する日本政府のご支援に、心より深く感謝申し上げます。同工場では、3nmプロセス技術による先端半導体の製造を計画しております。JASMへの設備投資額は、合計230億米ドルを超える見込みです。具体的な生産および投資計画は、市場需要に応じて段階的に実施するものとし、日本政府からの支援を前提に検討を進めていきます。JASMは、今後とも私たちのパートナーとともに、環境に配慮した革新的なグリーン製造技術を用いて、日本と世界中のお客様に先端技術を提供し、AI時代における強力な需要に対応していきます。

【媒體】
https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HU_Wy4jbcAABTys.png?name=orig

items.full_text:
【Raw_Inbox row21942】
(emoji)MS_2026 OCP Global Summit Takeaways
 
(emoji)網通產業持續朝更高傳輸頻寬發展，智邦與Celestica已展示1.6T交換器，但現階段更重要的趨勢是提升光連接方案的能源效率。CPO與NPO均為主要發展方向，其中NPO因CPO面臨技術挑戰而受到更多關注，未來連接器規格標準化亦有助於加速普及。
 
(emoji)銅連接方案仍具發展空間，Credo推出用於機櫃間傳輸的1.6T主動式電纜（AEC），Amphenol、TE Connectivity及Molex等廠商則布局機櫃內傳輸的448G CPC方案。Credo與ALAB的micro VCSEL光學模組具備較佳能源效率，在1.6T傳輸下每端功耗約12W，且於50至100公尺傳輸距離具備與銅連接相近的可靠性。中期而言，micro VCSEL有望在銅連接達到物理極限後取代短距離AEC，長期則可能整合至CPO架構，預期不同方案將依應用需求並存。
 
(emoji)電力供應方面，800V直流高壓供電（HVDC）成為另一項產業焦點，輝達除展示支援Vera Rubin NVL72機櫃的機櫃內電源架構外，也提出以660kW、800V直流電源機櫃支援兩座NVL72機櫃的設計，另有±400VDC直流方案。產業交流顯示，HVDC預計自2026年底開始小規模導入，並延續至2027年；後續Vera Rubin Ultra機櫃的功耗增加及機櫃間互連需求，可能進一步推動高壓直流供電發展，但液冷電源架構有助緩解空間限制。
 
(emoji)投資方面，貿聯-KY可望受惠於micro VCSEL光學方案普及，因其為Credo等廠商的組裝合作夥伴；致茂則受惠於電源測試、CPU／GPU／TPU系統級測試與終測，以及可插拔光學與CPO光子測試設備需求成長。台達電與光寶科將持續受惠於AI運算叢集功耗提升，但更顯著的成長動能可能取決於HVDC電源機櫃的導入速度。

【Raw_Inbox row22035】
🔥凱基投顧  余昀澄 (Alex)  

⭐️法說會重點摘要—曜越 (3540 TT)

2026/10/19

💎結論

公司展望AI工作站將成為2027年主要營收成長動能，且將帶動毛利率擴張。市場共識預估2026年EPS年減至0.45-0.5元，2027年年增至1.4-1.5元，目前股價交易於16-17倍2027年市場共識EPS預估。

💎重點摘要

1. 1H26 EPS 0.16元，較1H25成長主因業外收入挹注，營收、毛利率、營利率年減則因消費需求疲弱，且零組件漲價。

2. 公司由零組件跨入系統，1-3Q26 Gaming PC營收比重35%，後續新開發AI工作站產品，預計4Q26-2027年量體逐漸放大。

3. 針對關鍵零組件CPU、記憶體等有做策略性備貨，目前庫存水準約兩個月。

💎結論建議

1.廣告營收表現亮眼由單價上揚推動。我們觀察Tinuiti數據顯示Meta美國3Q26廣告營收年增17%較2Q26之11%加速，我們認為主要由廣告價格上揚推動而非曝光量，Birch數據顯示FB/IG CPM年增率於3Q26平均達30/44%較2Q26之9/22%加速成長，催化劑包含AdImpact預估期中選舉政治廣告支出US$10.8bn較2022年成長20%，廣告需求強勁、曝光成長有限外加AI提升轉換率推升廣告單價年增加速(vs. 市場共識成長減速)。

2.Muse帶動評價恢復先行，財務貢獻仍待驗證。Meta代理人產品Muse在美加地區推出後大受歡迎，Apptopia數據顯示Muse推出20天內累計下載量達580萬次，DAU約1百萬人，我們認為係因：1)Muse用戶結構約46%為46歲以上(vs. ChatGPT 21%)，意味中高齡用戶第一次接觸AI產品可能透過Meta渠道；2)Muse在產品設計上較為激進，較ChatGPT/Claude不會拒絕如預訂、付款等高風險操作。惟Appfigures數據顯示Muse推出11天後累計營收約US$27k佔比3Q26營收微乎其微，我們試算Meta One & Muse每1億用戶及3%滲透率假設下2027年營收增量US$720mn/0.3%(以Muse US$20/mon計算；vs. 月費US$3-100)，故仰賴額外廣告及代理商務變現。

3.資本支出市場共識應不減反增。先前媒體揭露Meta內部信顯示公司預計2026/27新增3.5/7GW容量至7/14GW應為樂觀情境(簽約而非通電上線)並涵蓋租賃/JV/SPV等供給，2Q26+7M26租賃義務US$347bn係屬長期資料中心基礎建設，我們預估Meta 2027自有建置量約4GW並以VR每GW平均建置成本約US$55-60bn(vs. 先前預估US$45-50bn)估算，資本支出約US$200-220bn高於市場共識12%。需求方面，Muse提供免費用戶每周1億Token使用額度，我們估算1億用戶在25%使用量及特定參數規模、GPU使用效率假設下即須0.5 GW的算力建置需求。

items.full_text:
【X @QQ_Timmy 2026-10-19 21:38 貼文 id=2112176439810560121】
https://x.com/QQ_Timmy/status/2112176439810560121  讚 18 / 瀏覽 3275

〈研調估2030年資料中心IT運算力年增70GW 液冷扮要角〉

1、規模：研調機構 Omdia 預測，到 2030 年，全球資料中心每年新增的 IT 運算能力約 70 GW，大部分增量 IT 負載會由液冷承擔，液冷將成為下一代 AI 基礎設施的主流熱管理方案。

2、主流技術：預測期間內，直接對晶片單相液冷（DtC/1P）會持續主導全球資料中心市場。浸沒式冷卻等其他架構雖然也會成長，但基於冷板的直接對晶片單相技術最適合改裝現有機架，也最能滿足 GPU 叢集的超高功率密度。

3、冷板價值提升：在直接對晶片單相液冷的價值鏈裡，冷板的營收占比預計從 2024 年的 40% 升到 2030 年的 61%。

4、冷板占比上升的三大原因：
一，應用範圍從 CPU、GPU 擴展到記憶體模組、供電元件和其他高發熱硬體。
二，採用先進的高性能材料提高熱導率，推升原材料成本和單價。
三，內部微通道結構持續優化，讓設計更好的冷板能拿到更高的產品溢價。

5、CDU 占比下滑：同一期間，冷卻液分配單元（CDU）在這個技術堆疊裡的營收占比會下降，原因有兩個。
一是 CDU 為支援更高機架功率密度而設計，每瓦冷卻能力的價格跟著下降。
二是大規模量產和供應鏈成熟，進一步壓低每瓦成本。CDU 市場總營收的絕對值仍會成長，只是占比萎縮，冷板則成為這個生態系裡最大、成長最快的價值區段。

【引用原文 @statementdog】
Omdia expects cold plates to account for 61% of revenue from single-phase direct-to-chip liquid cooling by 2030, up from 40% in 2024, Taiwan’s Central News Agency reports.

The firm says cold plates are being used on more components, including memory modules and power devices. Materials with higher thermal conductivity are raising costs, while improved microchannel designs support price premiums.

Coolant distribution units (CDUs) are expected to generate more revenue but account for a smaller share of the market. Omdia says their cost per watt of cooling capacity will fall as designs support higher rack power densities and production volumes grow.

Omdia expects single-phase direct-to-chip cooling to remain the leading approach. It sees cold plates as the most practical option for retrofitting existing racks and handling the high power density of GPU clusters.

https://www.cna.com.tw/news/afe/202610190058.aspx

Greater China Technology Hardware  | Asia Pacific
2026 OCP Global Summit 
Takeaways
Morgan Stanley Taiwan Limited+
Derrick Yang
Equity Analyst
                        Derrick.Yang@morganstanley.com                                                +886 2 2730-2862                    
Vivi Huang
Research Associate
                        Vivi.Huang@morganstanley.com                                                +886 2 2730-2860                    
Morgan Stanley Asia Limited+
Andy Meng, CFA
Equity Analyst
                        Andy.Meng@morganstanley.com                                                +852 2239-7689                    
Greater China Technology Hardware
Asia Pacific
Industry View In-Line
CPO/NPO and micro     VCSEL based   optical solutions are the 
focus for networking, while HVDC takes center stage for power. 
Higher bandwidth and better power efficiency: In the networking space, the 
migration into higher bandwidth continues, as players like Accton and Celestica 
showcased their 1.6T network switches. We think a bigger theme is the effort to 
improve the power efficiency of current mainstream pluggable optical solutions. 
First off, one well-discussed approach is the adoption CPO or NPO, and it seems the 
latter is gaining more attention due to the technical challenges in the former. Spec 
standardization, such as CPX connectors, could further accelerate the proliferation, 
in our view. Secondly, copper could still help, as Credo has its 1.6T AEC cables for 
inter-tray transmission while many other vendors (Amphenol, TE Connectivity, 
Molex, etc.) have their 448G CPC solutions for in-tray transmission. Lastly, the micro 
VCSEL based optical modules from Credo and ALAB represent another power 
efficient solution (12W/end at 1,6T), which has reliability comparable to copper 
(100M hours of MTBF/MTBI) for a transmission distance of 50-100m. We believe 
this micro VCSEL based solution could potentially replace the AEC for shorter 
distance transmission when copper hits the physical limit in the medium term and 
be integrated with the CPO architecture in the longer term. In sum, we believe the 
above-mentioned solutions are likely to co-exist for different use cases. 
800VDC for power delivery taking the center stage: While the Vera Rubin NVL72 
rack already has the in-rack power shelf reference design (110KW/shelf at 3+1 
redundancy), Nvidia unveiled another reference design this time, using one 660KW 
800VDC power rack to support two Vera Rubin NVL72 racks. Moreover, we also 
saw a few ±400VDC reference designs as well. Our conversations with companies 
on the exhibition floor indicate that the HVDC adoption should start from late 
2026, but likely at a small scale extending into 2027. The next checkpoint will be 
Vera Rubin Ultra racks, where increasing power consumption and more hardware 
devices for inter-rack scale-up network might take up more pace on the rack, though 
the liquid cooled power shelf  should ease the space budget a bit. We believe both 
solutions are progressing and will closely monitor the dynamics. 
Stock picks: We believe that Bizlink (3665.TW) should be a beneficiary of the 
proliferation of the micro VCSEL based optical solution, as it is the assembly partner 
for Credo and potentially others as well. Chroma (2360.TW) should see drivers 
from power testing, CPU/GPU/TPU SL T/FT, and photonics testing (pluggable/
CPO)tools. Delta( (2308.TW) and Lite-On (2301.TW) should continue to grow with 
the increasing power consumption of AI clusters, but more meaningful growth 
upside probably will depend on the penetration of HVDC power racks.

M
 Idea
2
2026 OCP Global Summit
Networking dealing with higher bandwidth and better power 
efficiency
1.6T network switch and 1.6T transceiver/AEC
CPO remains one of the focus in the networking space during the OCP Global Summit. 
Edgecore and  Celestica showcased its 1.6T network switches based on Tomahawk 6 ASIC, 
both for the regular model and the CPO model. Moreover, Edgecore also had its OCS 
switch model in the booth, which is based on its own LCOS technology. These 
demonstrate that both have the capability to accommodate the customer demand for 
network switches based on the optical architecture in the future. 
On the cable side, Credo showcased its 1.6T AEC, but did not comment on the roadmap of 
its 3.2T AEC. Our checks in the exhibition with industry players indicate that the 3.2T AEC 
might be a very challenging project, though efforts are still in place. 
Exhibit 1: Edgecore - 1.6T liquid cooled  network switch
Source: Morgan Stanley Research
Exhibit 2: Edgecore - 1.6T liquid cooled  switch spec
Source: Morgan Stanley Research
M
 Idea
Morgan Stanley Research 3
Exhibit 3: Credo - 1.6T AEC
Source: Morgan Stanley Research
Exhibit 4: Credo - PCIE Gen 6 AEC
Source: Morgan Stanley Research
CPX and NPX all marching forward
Though CPO remains as the holy grail in the space, its yield issue and lower serviceability 
still present challenges to the wider adoption in the near term. We believe that the efforts 
will continue, but the industry is simultaneously pursuing other more practical solutions 
to sort out the power consumption issue of the existing pluggable transceivers,  including 
NPO (near-packaged optics), CPC (co-packaged copper) and NPC (near-packaged copper)
Compared to CPO, NPO compromises on the power consumption, but in exchange it eases 
the stringent requirement on alignment and serviceability. Given its better technology 
readiness and more mature supply chain, we think it might see good traction in the 
coming years. 
M
 Idea
4
Exhibit 5: CPO - pros and cons
Source: Nvidia
Exhibit 6: NPO - advantages
Source: Huawei
CPC is also becoming a popular design in the networking space. While the 448G server 
copper lane is limited to less than 1m of effective transmission distance, it still fits well 
into the use case of intra tray interconnects. We have seen many suppliers showcase the 
adoption of CPC for between the front panel and chip. 
Exhibit 7: Molex- CPC
Source: Morgan Stanley Research
Exhibit 8: TE Connectivity - CPC
Source: Morgan Stanley Research
Besides, the initiative at Open CPX MSA is aiming at standardizing the connectors that 
could enable a pluggable architecture for CPO/CPC, though we think the structure looks 
M
 Idea
Morgan Stanley Research 5
more like NPO/NPC. 
Samtec's SI-FLY and Ciena's Vesta are both manufactured based on the CPX spec. 
moreover, Alpha Networks had a switch based on this CPX enabled pluggable optical 
modules
We believe this could further improve the serviceability of the NPO/NPC. 
Exhibit 9: Samtec - SI-FL Y CPX
Source: Morgan Stanley Research
Exhibit 10: Ciena - Vesta CPX
Source: Morgan Stanley Research
M
 Idea
6
Exhibit 11: Alpha Networks - CPX in network switch
Source: Morgan Stanley Research
VCSEL based optical solutions gaining more attention
In addition to CPO/NPO/CPC/NPC designs, we see the micro VCSEL based optical 
solutions are gaining more attention too. The value proposition is to leverage the wide 
and slow architecture for a relatively short transmission distance of 50-100m. It can 
achieve 1-2 pJ/bit of power consumption vs. 5-10pJ/bit for CPO and NPO architecture. The 
current generation can enable 32Gbps of bandwidth per lane and the 100-200Gbps of 
bandwidth per lane is in the roadmap.
M
 Idea
Morgan Stanley Research 7
Exhibit 12: ALAB - PCIE over VCSEL NPO 
Source: Morgan Stanley Research
Exhibit 13: ALAB - PCIE over VCSEL NPO
Source: Morgan Stanley Research
Credo is among one of the most aggressive promoters of this emerging architecture. It has 
been talking about its ALC cable for mor ethan one year, and this time we saw more 
concrete specs of its 1.6T ZeroFlap ALC, which comes in at the power consumption of 
12W/end to support 50m of transmission distance with the copper level reliability (100m 
hours of MTBF/MTBI)
M
 Idea
8
Exhibit 14: Credo -  ALC cable
Source: Morgan Stanley Research
Exhibit 15: Credo - ALC in NPO configuration
Source: Morgan Stanley Research
Bizlink is another active player in the micro VCSEL optical module space. It has been 
partnering with Credo for many years in the AEC cable assembly and we believe that it 
will also collaborate with Credo on its ALC cable. Back in late September 2026, Bizlink 
had announced to partner with ams-OSRAM on the micro VCSEL based optical module 
(see the report). Longer term, we believe that these initiatives, along with the shuffle box 
and FA alignment process, should help its diversify its data interconnect exposure more 
into the optical space, vs. current concentration on copper. 
M
 Idea
Morgan Stanley Research 9
Exhibit 16: Bizlink - shuffle box
Source: Morgan Stanley Research
Exhibit 17: Bizlink - FAU alignment and validation
Source: Bizlink
In sum, different solutions of data transmission are emerging, trying to improve the power 
consumption of the currently mainstream pluggable transceivers. We believe that these 
solutions will probably co exist for a while, as different use case could need different 
combination of cost and benefits. 
Power becoming another bottleneck in the AI deployment
HVDC adoption emerging from Vera Rubin
In the power space, HVDC has been one of the key focuses in the AI cluster, as the rapid 
increase in AI rack power density is creating growing challenges for conventional power-
distribution architectures. As rack-level power consumption rising from tens of kilowatts 
to several hundreds of KWs, electrical losses, cable size, thermal management 
requirements, and overall system complexity increase significantly. Under traditional low-
voltage power architectures, delivering larger amounts of power requires proportionally 
higher current, which increases resistive losses and places greater stress on cables, 
connectors, busbars, and power-conversion equipment.
At the same time, every power-conversion stage introduces efficiency losses and 
generates additional heat. As AI deployments scale into multi-megawatt and eventually 
gigawatt-level campuses, even small efficiency improvements can translate into 
M
 Idea
10
meaningful reductions in operating costs, cooling requirements, and infrastructure 
investment. Consequently, the industry is increasingly focused on power architectures 
that can reduce conversion stages, lower current levels, and improve overall power-
delivery efficiency.
Against this backdrop, high-voltage direct current (HVDC) is emerging as one of the most 
important architectural upgrades for next-generation AI infrastructure. By increasing 
distribution voltage, HVDC allows the same amount of power to be delivered at a lower 
current, reducing conduction losses and improving system efficiency. Higher-voltage 
architectures also improve scalability for ultra-high-density rack deployments by 
alleviating some of the physical and thermal constraints associated with conventional 
power-distribution systems.
Exhibit 18: Better power efficiency for 800VDC architecture
Source: Delta
Exhibit 19: Better efficiency leads to cost savings
Source: Delta
In a joint keynote speech by Delta and Nvidia, the roadmap illustrates the industry's 
gradual migration toward higher-voltage power architectures. Earlier AI server generations 
primarily utilized conventional power-delivery schemes centered around rack-level 48V 
distribution. As rack power requirements increased with Blackwell-generation systems, 
industry participants began evaluating higher-voltage architectures capable of supporting 
substantially greater power density. Looking ahead, the industry is increasingly converging 
around 800VDC as a potential next-generation standard for large-scale AI deployments, 
particularly as rack-level power consumption approaches several hundred kilowatts. The 
transition reflects the need to improve power-distribution efficiency while supporting the 
continued growth of AI computing infrastructure.
Though we also saw the 800VDC power rack reference design for the Vera Rubin rack in a 
1-to-2 configuration (one 660KW power rack supporting two Vera Rubin racks), we think 
the adoption of this solution might be relatively low, since the Vera Rubin rack also has a 
reference design for the in-rack power shelf design

The next key check point to watch should be the Vera Rubin Ultra generation, as the 
power consumption per rack shall continue to increase and there might be more hardware 
devices to enable the inter-rack scale up network, both could take up more space on the 
IT rack. That said, the power shelf will shift from air cooling into liquid cooling, which 
could narrow the power shelf height by 1U to free up some space as well. Our checks 
indicate that both the in-rack power shelf and 800VDC power rack solutions are ongoing 
now, and we believe that rack space, power redundancy and system reliability are all the

Looking further ahead, Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) represent a potential next-
generation evolution of power infrastructure. Unlike traditional transformers that operate 
primarily as passive devices, SSTs leverage power electronics to provide voltage 
conversion, power conditioning, and bidirectional energy management within a single 
platform. This enables greater controllability and flexibility while supporting increasingly 
digitalized power networks.
Although SSTs remain at an early stage of commercialization and face challenges related 
to economics, reliability, and large-scale deployment, the technology aligns well with long-
term data center trends. As AI campuses evolve into utility-scale power consumers 
incorporating energy storage, distributed generation, and advanced power management, 
SSTs could eventually become a key enabling technology.

upgrades, SSTs represent a longer-term technology roadmap that could further transform 
how future data centers distribute and manage electricity.

Industry View In-Line
CPO/NPO and micro     VCSEL based   optical solutions are the
focus for networking, while HVDC takes center stage for power.
Higher bandwidth and better power efficiency: In the networking space, the
migration into higher bandwidth continues, as players like Accton and Celestica
showcased their 1.6T network switches. We think a bigger theme is the effort to
improve the power efficiency of current mainstream pluggable optical solutions.
First off, one well-discussed approach is the adoption CPO or NPO, and it seems the
latter is gaining more attention due to the technical challenges in the former. Spec
standardization, such as CPX connectors, could further accelerate the proliferation,
in our view. Secondly, copper could still help, as Credo has its 1.6T AEC cables for
inter-tray transmission while many other vendors (Amphenol, TE Connectivity,
Molex, etc.) have their 448G CPC solutions for in-tray transmission. Lastly, the micro
VCSEL based optical modules from Credo and ALAB represent another power
efficient solution (12W/end at 1,6T), which has reliability comparable to copper
(100M hours of MTBF/MTBI) for a transmission distance of 50-100m. We believe
this micro VCSEL based solution could potentially replace the AEC for shorter
distance transmission when copper hits the physical limit in the medium term and
be integrated with the CPO architecture in the longer term. In sum, we believe the
above-mentioned solutions are likely to co-exist for different use cases.
800VDC for power delivery taking the center stage: While the Vera Rubin NVL72
rack already has the in-rack power shelf reference design (110KW/shelf at 3+1
redundancy), Nvidia unveiled another reference design this time, using one 660KW
800VDC power rack to support two Vera Rubin NVL72 racks. Moreover, we also
saw a few ±400VDC reference designs as well. Our conversations with companies
on the exhibition floor indicate that the HVDC adoption should start from late
2026, but likely at a small scale extending into 2027. The next checkpoint will be
Vera Rubin Ultra racks, where increasing power consumption and more hardware
devices for inter-rack scale-up network might take up more pace on the rack, though
the liquid cooled power shelf  should ease the space budget a bit. We believe both
solutions are progressing and will closely monitor the dynamics.
Stock picks: We believe that Bizlink (3665.TW) should be a beneficiary of the
proliferation of the micro VCSEL based optical solution, as it is the assembly partner
for Credo and potentially others as well. Chroma (2360.TW) should see drivers
from power testing, CPU/GPU/TPU SL T/FT, and photonics testing (pluggable/
CPO)tools. Delta( (2308.TW) and Lite-On (2301.TW) should continue to grow with
the increasing power consumption of AI clusters, but more meaningful growth
upside probably will depend on the penetration of HVDC power racks.
